title: Senior Creative Performance Strategist
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is a technology-driven growth marketing firm focused on growth-stage consumer companies. We were founded in 2017 out of a conviction that the iconic ad agencies of tomorrow would look very different. Darkroom is a human services firm built on a universal AI commerce layer called Matter. Our model deploys a unique blend of senior, human resources enriched by an agentic technology stack that enhances output, efficiency, and revenue generation for our clients.

Our team has been responsible for billions of dollars in trackable revenue across e-commerce marketplace, direct-to-consumer, and social commerce programs under management. Using research aggregated across these engagements, we accelerate results for our portfolio by developing high-impact digital strategies that unlock gateways to revenue growth, transform marketing operations, and prioritize profitability. What started as a boutique design agency evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000), one of the most successful results-driven performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos), and earned Forbes 30 Under 30 recognition for our founders’ contribution in Marketing & Advertising (Forbes).

The Role

We’re looking for a visionary creative leader with deep experience in developing ad concepts for acquisition marketing on Meta. You’re able to dive deep into the pixels and give tactical feedback on design and video, but understand how to thread the needle between performance frameworks, creative testing, and world-building assets. You’re likely a Designer or Creative Strategist by trade but hyper-focused on paid media.

You’ll work on our Performance Creative service, an AI-powered creative strategy engagement for paid media clients. This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of creativity, AI, and performance — combining bold visual storytelling with data-informed design decisions. You'll report to the Director of Creative and lead the management of Designers and Editors to execute paid media assets across a variety of formats, including static ads, short-form videos, motion graphics, and UGC content.

Your work will directly impact client performance by delivering a high-volume of ad concepts, elevated creative direction, and data-backed testing frameworks. You’ll collaborate closely with performance marketers, designers, and video editors in a fast-paced, remote environment.

This is a fully remote role operating in the EST Time Zone and all business is conducted 100% in English. Open to candidates in the following locations: Brazil, Mexico, Portugal, and Spain.

What You’ll Do

Management Responsibilities

  • Manage a team of 2-4 designers focused on paid ad creative, with room to grow the team over time.
  • Provide creative direction, actionable feedback, and career support through regular 1:1s and project reviews.
  • Oversee creative quality, ensuring assets align with brand identity, platform best practices, and campaign objectives.
  • Partner with performance marketers and strategists to develop and iterate on high-performing ad campaigns.
  • Help refine internal processes, establish creative standards, and lead collaborative sessions to drive creative innovation.

Senior Individual Contributor Responsibilities

  • Lead concept development and execution for paid media campaigns across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and display platforms.
  • Translate client’s marketing strategy and performance data into clear, compelling ad concepts.
  • Design and direct a range of assets including static ads, animations, mobile-first videos, and storyboards for short-form content.
  • Present creative work to stakeholders and clients with clarity, confidence, and strategic rationale.
  • Monitor performance data in collaboration with the marketing team to inform creative iterations and improve results over time.

You should apply if this sounds like you

  • 3+ years of senior-level design experience, with at least 1 year of people management experience preferred. Must have experience designing ad creatives for paid media campaigns across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, or similar platforms.
  • A digital portfolio showcasing performance-focused ad creative — including static ads, motion graphics, and short-form video — with a strong understanding of visual hierarchy, composition, and platform-specific best practices.
  • Knowledge of how to incorporate AI software into workflows to increase efficiencies and output, including ChatGPT, Midjourney, Perplexity, Icon, and more.
  • Self-motivated, proactive, and detail-oriented with a strong sense of ownership and accountability to performance results.
  • Skilled at working with performance marketers and creative strategists to write briefs, incorporate feedback, and iterate based on ad performance data.
  • Comfortable communicating in English with internal teams and clients, including presenting creative work and responding to feedback clearly and professionally.
  • Confident giving constructive feedback to other designers and supporting their growth through clear direction and mentorship.
  • Able to take ambiguous campaign goals and turn them into creative concepts that are visually engaging and conversion-focused.
  • Proficient in Figma for ad design workflows; knowledge of Auto Layout, Components, and asset handoff is essential.
  • Experience using Adobe Creative Suite (especially Photoshop and Illustrator) for asset creation and layout design.
  • Bonus: Experience designing high-performing ads for e-commerce brands, familiarity with motion design tools (After Effects, Premiere), or working with UGC creators and editors.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable. We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics. If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

Location and benefits — Remote-first culture with hubs in the Bay Area, New York, Philly, Lisbon, Sao Paulo, and Barcelona; flexible parental leave benefits; opportunities for cross-functional growth and collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

Seniority level

  • Mid-Senior level

Employment type

  • Full-time

Job function

  • Marketing and Sales
  • Industries: Advertising Services

This role supports Finance and Accounting operations by ensuring clean, consistent, and well-tested financial data across all core accounting modules — including Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), General Ledger (GL), and Payroll. The ideal candidate has a strong foundation in accounting, hands-on NetSuite experience, and enjoys a structured, process-driven environment. Founded in 2019 by two best friends, Jon and Eli, XILO set out to revolutionize the insurance industry by solving its biggest challenges. As a Product Designer at XILO, you’ll play a critical role in shaping the entire user experience, from initial concept to final visual design. By turning customer insights into impactful and aesthetically pleasing designs, you’ll make our products more intuitive, self-servicing, and valuable.   • Conduct 3 customer interviews with a Product Manager weekly to gather actionable feedback for design improvements.

  • Ensure all current products are intuitive and self-servicing for users.
  • Drive improved adoption and engagement across all current products.

What we’re looking for

  • Extremely curious and inquisitive, with a passion for understanding user needs.

  • Proven expertise in UI design, with a strong portfolio showcasing your work with design systems, mockups, and prototypes.
  • Quick learner who can master the industry and product in a short time.
  • Extensive knowledge of design principles, UX/UI best practices, and proficiency in modern design tools.
  • Relentless work ethic: willing to go the extra mile (10+ hours daily when needed).

  • Builds genuine relationships with team members and customers.
  • Positive, motivating, and supportive team player.
  • Accountable for successes and failures, with a focus on doing the job right.
  • Balances leadership with hands-on contributions (player-coach mentality).
  • Passionate about AI and its potential to transform industries

What we offer

  • Collaborative and innovative work environment.
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Budget for English lessons.

Why Join XILO?

Be part of a mission-driven team at the forefront of AI innovation and SaaS technology. As a Product Designer at XILO, you’ll have the opportunity to own the user experience and interface of a cutting-edge platform, deliver career-defining work, and make a lasting impact on a rapidly growing company.

At XILO, we don’t stop until the job is done. If you’re ready to roll up your sleeves, embrace challenges, and make a meaningful impact, we’d love to hear from you.

Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets. We offer lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries. Our team is a diverse group that believes digital assets can democratize access to the global economy. Our core values are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. We are building, innovating and revolutionizing financial services.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full-time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate supports end users, manages endpoints, automates identity and access management, and administers cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated prior success in similar roles within rapidly growing, security-first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code, and is excited to design, implement and manage our growing cloud-first infrastructure and networks. You will work closely with Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams including Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR. You will be a strong communicator and fast learner, seeking a supportive environment to grow your IT skills and expertise. This role reports to the Director of IT.

What You’ll Do / Responsibilities

  • Be customer-facing and the first line of support for employees via Slack, Jira, and other channels.
  • Pro­cure and deliver technology equipment and own the tech onboarding and offboarding experience.
  • Design, test, build, and document programs, policies and tools; contribute improvements to existing knowledge bases.
  • Support and manage SaaS applications (Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro/Protect/Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.).
  • Manage Mac endpoints and mobile device management tools (MDM/EMM, Jamf, etc.).
  • Improve IDP and SSO tooling (GSuite, Okta, etc.) and document solutions; automate routine work.
  • Lead incident response for critical issues and manage tickets with prioritization and escalation as needed.
  • Work on projects across sprints with agile methodologies and track work in Jira.
  • Set and pursue objectives and key results aligned to team and company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration (e.g., Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite).
  • Ability to create automations using Bash, Zsh, Python, etc.; experience with open source tools (Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.).
  • Experience integrating SSO into Okta and building workflows; strong API integration skills.
  • Remote support experience across multiple countries/time zones; capable of hardware shipping/receiving and customs.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication; ability to explain complex concepts clearly and empathetically.
  • Proficiency in security practices, PGP basics, networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing/switching); methodical troubleshooting following OSI layers.
  • Self-management skills to scope projects and work across multiple teams.

Nice to Have / Preferred Qualifications

  • Some familiarity with AWS; experience using GAM and CLI for efficiency.
  • Jamf, Okta, and Google Workspace certifications.

Culture & Fit

  • Leadership mindset suitable for a startup/tech environment; values-focused with empathy and integrity.
  • Ability to work remotely and navigate ambiguity in a high-growth setting.

Benefits & Responsibilities of Belonging

  • Competitive total rewards package starting from day one, including a PTO package and ownership through equity.
  • Remote work opportunity worldwide for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).
  • Purpose-driven work in a global digital asset company; commitment to inclusivity and diversity.

Equality & Recruitment Notes

Ledn is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. If accommodation is needed during the recruitment process, please email the Ledn team with your request; all inquiries are confidential. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes, and we are not responsible for fees related to them.

description:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, or equivalent experience.

  • Relational DB experience at scale: administration, data modeling, query optimization

  • Experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL a strong plus!)

  • Strong aptitude to understand and learn new software products.

  • A strong sense of curiosity and a willingness to wade into the unknown and learn as you go.

Our Commitment:

  • We respond to every applicant.

  • We review applications fairly and objectively, and shortlist based on relevant skills and experience.

TigerData, formerly Timescale, sets the standard as the fastest PostgreSQL platform for modern workloads. Trusted by more than 2,000 customers across 25+ countries and powering over 3 million active databases, we enable developers and organizations to build real-time, intelligent applications at scale. Backed by $180 million from top-tier investors, TigerData is building the new standard for data infrastructure, built on PostgreSQL, designed for the future.

We embrace diversity, curiosity, and collaboration. Whether debating the perfect chicken nugget crunch , sharing workout routines , or discussing your favorite plants and pets , you'll find your community here.

Our Tech Stack:

We don't require previous experience with our tech stack, but enthusiasm for learning is key. Our technologies include PostgreSQL, Tiger Cloud, AWS, Go, Docker, Kubernetes, Python, and innovative features like Hypertables, Hypercore, vector search, and real-time analytics.

Learn more at or follow us on Twitter @TigerDatabase

The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. Ledn aims to be an unstoppable force in changing the world for the better. Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services.

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full-time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many hats, including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar roles in rapidly growing, security-first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and infrastructure as code, and is excited to help end users who need assistance.

You will participate in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud-first infrastructure and networks. You will be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment and work closely with Cybersecurity/IT peers and stakeholder teams (Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR). The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner seeking a supportive environment to grow IT skills and expertise. This role reports to the Director of IT.

About the Role

You will be customer-facing and the first line of support; you own support and are passionate about providing an outstanding experience to employees via Slack, Jira, etc. We are primarily Mac environments. You will procure and deliver technology equipment and manage tech onboarding for new employees and tech retrieval for departing employees.

You will design, test, build, and document programs, policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge. You will support and manage SaaS applications such as Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro/Protect/Connect, Okta, Jira, etc. You will manage Mac endpoints and mobile device management tools (MDM/EMM) and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta). You will create solution documentation and automation to reduce manual work. You will manage incidents and tickets, prioritize workload, and participate in projects over sprints using Jira and agile methods. You will set objectives and key results aligned with team and company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn: 7+ years in SaaS systems administration (Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite). Automation skills (bash, zsh, python). Experience with open source tools (Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.). Ability to integrate SSO into Okta, create workflows, and work with APIs to connect systems. Remote support across multiple countries/time zones; familiarity with hardware shipping and customs. Excellent written and verbal communication across media. Ability to draft clear tickets, emails, and Slack messages. Comfort with security principles and basic networking (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing, OSI model). Self-management with the ability to scope work and coordinate across teams. Strong organizational and task-management skills; comfort with ambiguity.

Nice to Have: Some familiarity with AWS; experience with GAM and command-line interfaces; certifications (Jamf, Okta, Google Workspace). Culture fit: leadership mindset, adaptability, empathy, and a collaborative approach in a remote, fast-paced environment.

What We Provide

Comprehensive total rewards package, remote-friendly with up to 180 days remote eligibility (subject to restrictions); ownership in the company through equity; a purpose-driven career; inclusive, diverse, and equal opportunity employer. We welcome accommodation requests via email for recruitment process stages; responses are confidential.

Company and Hiring Notes

Ledn’s team is global, remote-first, with presence across North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe. Due to high volume of applications, only qualified applicants will be contacted. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response; we may review publicly available social media relevant to the role. No agencies or recruiters please. description:
Overview

Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. We are trusted by over 280 million people in 100+ countries for our industry-leading security, user fund transparency, trading engine speed, deep liquidity, and an unmatched portfolio of digital-asset products. Binance offerings range from trading and finance to education, research, payments, institutional services, Web3 features, and more. We leverage the power of digital assets and blockchain to build an inclusive financial ecosystem to advance the freedom of money and improve financial access for people around the world.

Company Overview: Simpaul is 100% a Binance Company. The M&A was fully approved by the Brazilian Central Bank in December 2024. This strategic acquisition strengthens our presence in the Brazilian market and enhances our capabilities in the fintech sector.

Role We are seeking an experienced Senior Finance & Accounting Specialist.

This role is critical in ensuring the accuracy, compliance, and efficiency of our financial operations in Brazil, in alignment with both local regulatory requirements and Binance’s global standards. You will be the main point of contact for accounting, tax, and regulatory matters, supporting the business in a fast-paced and high-growth environment.

Note: This role is 100% Remote, Work From Home based. Working Visa is not sponsored.

Responsibilities

  • Oversee the month-end and year-end closing processes in accordance with local Brazilian regulations — particularly Receita Federal and Banco Central do Brasil — while ensuring compliance with Binance’s global finance policies.
  • Collaborate closely with the internal finance team to manage accounting and financial processes, ensuring accurate and timely accounting and tax closing.
  • Act as the primary liaison with the external accounting firm, monitoring deliverables, service quality, and outcomes.
  • Serve as the subject matter expert for Finance/Accounting in implementing upcoming cryptoasset regulations in Brazil, advising on impacts, requirements, and execution plans.
  • Monitor, analyze, and ensure accurate and timely submission of all regulatory reports to authorities such as the Banco Central do Brasil and Receita Federal do Brasil (e.g., CADOCs, statutory financial and tax filings).
  • Develop and maintain the company’s accounting, operational, and capital policies in line with current regulations, business needs, and Binance’s strategic directives (e.g., capital adequacy policies vs. transaction accounting).
  • Track and interpret changes in laws, resolutions, and regulatory instructions related to brokerage and payment activities, ensuring ongoing compliance and regulatory security.
  • Oversee and support all tax-related initiatives, including compliance with tax obligations, implementation of tax reform changes, and corporate reorganization or optimization projects.
  • Lead external audit activities, ensuring alignment with both regulatory requirements and Binance’s internal policies and practices.
  • Drive and support system implementation projects and the launch of new products, focusing on financial and accounting requirements.
  • Collaborate with other teams across the company on business process development, monitoring, and continuous improvement (e.g., internal audit, internal controls, policy updates).
  • Support Binance’s regional Finance and Treasury teams with inquiries, process adjustments, and compliance initiatives to align reporting and operations with corporate policies (e.g., consolidated results reporting).

Requirements

  • 7+ years of relevant experience in Controllership, Accounting Management, or Finance for banking, payment, or other regulated financial institutions.
  • Strong knowledge in accounting, finance, financial operations, cash management, tax, and payment processes.
  • Proven experience in financial products, financial back-office operations, and banking relationship management.
  • Previous exposure to core banking systems (preferred).

Why Binance

  • Shape the future with the world’s leading blockchain ecosystem
  • Collaborate with world-class talent in a user-centric global organization with a flat structure
  • Tackle unique, fast-paced projects with autonomy in an innovative environment
  • Thrive in a results-driven workplace with opportunities for career growth and continuous learning
  • Competitive salary and company benefits
  • Work-from-home arrangement (the arrangement may vary depending on the work nature of the business team)

Binance is committed to being an equal opportunity employer. We believe that having a diverse workforce is fundamental to our success.

Sobre a Lemon

As mudanças climáticas são um desafio complexo, mas as soluções não podem ser. Enquanto as ações climáticas forem de difícil acesso, nunca teremos um impacto unificado grande o bastante para fazer a diferença no planeta.

A Lemon é o jeito mais simples para empresas e pessoas impactarem positivamente o meio ambiente por meio de uma energia mais barata e limpa. Entregamos uma energia diferente da tradicional, por isso conseguimos oferecer uma conta de luz mais econômica e sustentável. Somos comprometidos com nossos clientes e com o planeta, por isso garantimos sempre um atendimento mais próximo e inovações que incentivam mudanças no setor elétrico.

Somos apoiados pelos principais investidores em tecnologia de todo o mundo, incluindo fundos de venture capital como Kaszek, Lowercarbon Capital, Canary, Big Bets e Actyus. Endereçar um dos desafios mais significativos do mundo requer pensamento inovador e perspectivas diversas. description:
Overview

Managers of Information Technology, Ledn is seeking an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full-time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. We are a global financial services company built for digital assets, delivering lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries. Our team is passionate, diverse, and committed to democratizing access to the global economy through Ledn’s products and services.

The role reports to the Director of IT.

The Opportunity

You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud-first infrastructure and networks. You will work closely with Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams including Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR. You will be customer-facing, the first line of support; you own support and you are passionate about providing an outstanding support experience to our employees via Slack, Jira, etc.

Key responsibilities include:

  • You will be responsible for procuring and delivering technology equipment.
  • You will own the onboarding experience for all new employees and the retrieval of all outgoing employees.
  • You will design, test, build, and document programs, policies and tools; contribute improvements to knowledge bases.
  • You will support and manage SaaS applications such as Google Workspace (GSuite), Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.
  • You will manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools (MDM, EMM, Jamf, etc.).
  • You will own and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.).
  • You will detail solutions, craft help articles and automate busywork.
  • Manage, respond to, and resolve critical incidents and issues as needed, through to completion.
  • Balance help desk tickets while prioritising effectively and work on projects over sprints with Jira and agile methods.
  • Set and pursue objectives and key results aligned to team and company goals.

What You Bring To Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc.
  • Experience with open-source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • Ability to integrate SSO into Okta and create workflows in Okta.
  • Experience with APIs and integrating systems.
  • Remote support experience across multiple countries/time zones; familiarity with shipping and receiving hardware and customs.
  • Excellent communication skills across media; ability to explain complex topics clearly and calmly.

  • A commitment to security, including knowledge of PGP.
  • Understanding of networking fundamentals and basic troubleshooting (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching).
  • Ability to methodically troubleshoot problems using OSI layers; capable of self-management and prioritising across multiple teams.
  • Strong organizational and task-management skills; comfortable dealing with ambiguity and making decisions with incomplete data.

Nice To Haves

  • Some familiarity with AWS; prior usage is acceptable without certifications.
  • Experience with GAM and command-line interfaces to improve efficiency.
  • Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.

Culture Fit

  • We look for more than operational excellence — a leader who thrives in a startup/tech environment and embodies our values.
  • Have a passion for progress by being adaptable and resilient in a high-growth, fast-paced environment.
  • Builder's mindset; excited to create, iterate, and scale IT practices.
  • Collaborative partner capable of influencing across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity.
  • Demonstrate integrity and accountability in handling confidential information across diverse contexts.
  • Experience working in a remote environment.

description:
Somos a Rede Hospital Casa, um dos maiores operadores médicos hospitalares independentes do estado do Rio de Janeiro. O ACOLHIMENTO COMO NOSSO JEITO DE CUIDAR está entre os nossos principais valores.

Estamos em busca de um profissional para atuar como ENFERMEIRO EMERGÊNCIA que seja proativo, cuidadoso, dedicado e que tenha uma atenção e amor com seus processos de trabalho.

Suas principais atividades serão:

  • Participar e dar continuidade às atividades executadas pela Gerência e Coordenação de Enfermagem;
  • Respeitar a hierarquia do Organograma da Enfermagem e instituição;
  • Exercer a função assistencial e administrativa, educativa, de pesquisa e social em concordância com a Gerência de Enfermagem;
  • Participar das reuniões com a Gerência de Enfermagem, CIPA, CCIH, Serviço de Educação Continuada e demais comissões instituídas na empresa/instituição;
  • Auxiliar na identificação dos fatores que favorecem e os que dificultam o processo de enfermagem;
  • Zelar pelas condições ambientais de segurança do setor buscando o bem-estar da equipe interdisciplinar;
  • Solucionar as intercorrências, visando um bom padrão de assistência ao cliente;
  • Atender as necessidades da sua equipe de enfermagem orientando-os e supervisionando, e dos pacientes, priorizando pelo grau de dependência;
  • Fazer cumprir as normas e rotinas já existentes, incluindo as da CCIH, de acordo com os POPs;
  • Participar da passagem de plantão leito a leito, passando ou recebendo os pacientes, com os prontuários em ordem: impressos identificados, medicação verificada, artigos com data de trocas em dia, exames realizados e anotações claras, conferência de materiais do setor e expurgo limpo e organizado;
  • Realizar a cada plantão, registro no Livro de Ordens e Ocorrências, descrevendo o quantitativo de equipe presente, preenchendo o check list (materiais permanentes e controle de pacientes), anotando as intercorrências e informações relevantes;
  • Ler o Livro de Ocorrências diariamente;
  • Assegurar as conformidades quanto às metas planejadas pelo Núcleo de Segurança do Paciente (NSP);
  • Identificar as não conformidades e garantir a abertura das Notificações do NSP;
  • Realizar a admissão do paciente e evolução diária, preenchendo corretamente o impresso de Sistematização de Assistência de Enfermagem (SAE) para pacientes que irão internar e permanecer por mais de 6 horas no setor, antes de ser encaminhado ao setor de internação;
  • Assistir ao paciente diretamente, principalmente os mais graves, atendendo a todas as suas necessidades básicas afetadas, promovendo condições adequadas para seu repouso e recuperação;
  • Realizar os procedimentos técnicos de maior complexidade, de competência do enfermeiro, como curativos, cateterismos vesical, sondagem vesical, nasogástrica e nasoentérico, não podendo ser delegado aos técnicos, lembrando-se de registrar tudo corretamente na evolução do paciente;
  • Aprazar a prescrição médica, obedecendo à padronização determinada, observando que sejam obedecidos todos os cuidados;
  • Preparar e instalar os drippings dos pacientes, delegando essa função à equipe técnica somente na presença de eventualidades;
  • Encaminhar aos setores responsáveis, pedido de exames e autorização de materiais especiais, devidamente protocolados;
  • Informar ao médico plantonista as intercorrências que venham a ocorrer com o paciente ou com a terapêutica adotada;
  • Atender situações de urgência e emergência, identificando sinais de deterioração clínica;
  • Chamar equipe médica e fisioterapeuta para o atendimento e situações emergenciais; com o médico na realização de exames e tratamentos;
  • Dar informação ao paciente quanto à terapêutica e os exames solicitados;
  • Certificar o uso correto da pulseira de identificação e realizar corretamente a identificação do paciente;
  • Acompanhar o paciente até o Setor de Radiologia e assisti-lo durante a realização de todo o exame;
  • Supervisionar o acompanhamento do paciente até o Centro Cirúrgico, caso este necessite de intervenção cirúrgica;
  • Acompanhar o paciente até o quarto no momento da alta para a Unidade de Internação/Centro de Terapia Intensiva, passando o plantão para o integrante da equipe de enfermagem responsável;

Esperamos que você tenha:

  • Nível superior em Enfermagem
  • Desejável experiência de 6 meses na função
  • Especialização na área de EMERGÊNCIA
  • Mediação de conflitos, procedimentos de enfermagem BLS, ACLS
  • Pacote office

description:
ASPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas,Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Assim, a SPDM contribui de forma efetiva para a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados pelo Sistema Único de Saúde do Brasil, visando principalmente garantir a universalidade e as oportunidades de acesso à saúde, necessárias ao desenvolvimento humano e social do cidadão. Para tanto, associa o melhor da tecnologia com atendimento médico de alta qualidade, respaldado por equipes multiprofissionais, formadas por enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêuticos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos, bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas, entre outros.

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades no ano de 2001 no município de São Paulo, se estendendo para outros municípios e estados. Desde o início de suas atividades, oPAIS busca, em parceria com a gestão pública, o crescimento e a consolidação dos serviços de saúde ofertados aos usuários do SUS.

O Programa tem como objetivo garantir mudanças nos indicadores e na qualidade de vida da população, pautado, entre outros, pelos princípios da integralidade e da equidade, com uma visão estratégica da gestão dos serviços de saúde, definida em um processo de aprimoramento contínuo.

Realizar avaliações com equipe multiprofissional, emitir laudos e encaminhamentos para crianças com suspeita de autismo;

Realizar avaliação, triagem e encaminhamento para as terapias necessárias para os pacientes das reabilitações neurológica pediatrica e intelectual pediatrica;

Auxiliar na construção do Projeto Terapêutico Singular dos pacientes, a ser desenvolvido por equipe multiprofissional;

Prescrever medicamentos e realizar os ajustes necessários das dosagens para os pacientes absorvidos pelas reabilitações neurológica pediatrica e intelectual pediatrica;

Realizar consultas de acompanhamento para os pacientes das reabilitações neurológica pediatrica e intelectual pediatrica;

Realizar renovação de laudos;

Evoluir os atendimentos em prontuário eletrônico.

Ensino Superior em Medicina;

Residência ou título de especialista em neurologia pediátrica;

description:
We are seeking a highly skilled and detail-oriented Senior Manual Tester to join our dynamic team. This role is critical in ensuring the quality and reliability of our applications by verifying functionality against detailed specifications. The ideal candidate will play a pivotal role in the software development lifecycle by designing, executing, and managing comprehensive manual test plans and cases. Working closely with QA leads, developers, and business analysts, the Senior Manual Tester will help deliver robust, defect-free software solutions that meet and exceed customer expectations in a fast-paced Agile environment.

Responsibilities

  • Building, modifying, and executing detailed test plans, test cases, and scripts to validate application functionality. This includes covering both positive and negative scenarios to ensure comprehensive test coverage.
  • Identifying, reporting, and tracking defects through to closure using Azure DevOps Test Plan features. Collaborate with development teams to prioritize and resolve issues efficiently.
  • Actively participate in Agile Scrum ceremonies such as sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives. Review requirements and acceptance criteria to ensure clarity and testability.
  • Work closely with QA leads, developers, and business analysts to understand business needs and technical requirements, ensuring alignment and quality delivery.
  • Create and maintain detailed documentation of test cases, test results, and defect reports to support transparency and traceability.
  • Perform thorough manual testing to validate new features and existing functionality, ensuring the software meets business and technical requirements.
  • While primarily focused on manual testing, understand automated test script execution and results to complement manual efforts and improve overall test coverage.
  • Provide regular updates on testing progress, risks, and issues to stakeholders, ensuring timely communication and resolution.
  • Contribute to process improvements in testing methodologies, tools, and best practices to enhance team efficiency and product quality.
  • SQL: Proficient in writing complex SQL queries to validate data integrity and support backend testing. Ability to analyze and manipulate data sets to verify application behavior.
  • Oracle PL/SQL: Strong experience with Oracle PL/SQL for database testing, including writing and executing stored procedures, functions, and triggers to validate business logic at the database level.
  • Microsoft Excel: Advanced skills in Microsoft Excel, particularly with functions like VLOOKUP and XLOOKUP, to analyze test data, compare results, and generate reports efficiently.
  • Azure DevOps: Hands-on experience with Azure DevOps Test Plan features for managing test cases, executing tests, logging defects, and tracking progress within an Agile environment.
  • Manual Testing: Expertise in manual functional testing, including designing test cases, executing tests, and validating application features against requirements.
  • Functional Testing: Deep understanding of functional testing principles to ensure that software behaves as expected under various conditions.
  • Scrum: Active participation in Agile Scrum ceremonies, with a solid understanding of Agile methodologies and the ability to work effectively in iterative development cycles.
  • Defect Management: Skilled in identifying, documenting, prioritizing, and tracking defects to resolution, ensuring high-quality deliverables.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Ultra Edit: Familiarity with Ultra Edit or similar advanced text editors to review and analyze code snippets, logs, or configuration files during testing.
  • PeopleSoft HCM: Experience with PeopleSoft Human Capital Management (HCM) systems, understanding core modules and workflows to better test related applications.
  • Benefits Module: Knowledge of Benefits modules within PeopleSoft or similar HR systems to validate features related to employee benefits administration.
  • Payroll Module: Understanding of Payroll modules and processes to effectively test payroll-related functionalities and integrations.

Teaching and mentoring students (using Python and C#) for:

  • CSE 111 - Programming with Functions
  • CSE 210 - Programming with Classes
  • CSE 212 - Programming with Data Structures

These courses provide students with foundational computer programming skills, enabling them to contribute to software development teams.

Position Summary

BYU Pathway and BYU Idaho online courses are structured to include both an instructor and graders. Instructors are responsible for teaching and overall course delivery, while graders support the learning process by reviewing and evaluating assignments and providing students with constructive feedback. We are seeking instructors who will apply their skills and subject matter expertise to mentor students and facilitate teaching/learning experiences.

Qualifications

Specific Course Requirements: Computer Programming

  • A bachelor’s degree and 3-5 years of work experience may be considered.
  • Experience with Python, C#, or Java is required.
  • Expert proficiency with basic programming concepts, such as variables, data types, collections, loops, functions, libraries, I/O, error handling, and testing.
  • Expert proficiency with basic object-oriented programming concepts, such as classes, methods, variables, and access modifiers.
  • Familiarity with data structures and algorithms.
  • Understanding object-oriented principles, such as abstraction, encapsulation, polymorphism, and inheritance.
  • Experience with version control software, such as GitHub.
  • Experience with code editors, such as Visual Studio Code.
  • Ability to communicate clearly in writing.

  • 1 Controlled process or utility discharges from area of responsibility to the environment are within prescribed limits.

  • 3 Equipment, waste or other materials for disposal are segregated properly and dealt with according to the correct procedure.
  • 7) Emergency Response
  • 1 Carry Out Emergency Response role (See Station Bill).
  • 2 Demonstrate competence in Emergency Response drills and exercises.

A WAY Investimentos , fundada em 2008, com sede no Rio de Janeiro, é uma empresa de assessoria de investimentos com mais de 1.900 clientes ativos e R$1,7 bilhões sob assessoria na XP , BNY Mellon e Intrag. Somos membros A20 XP , grupo constituído pelas 20 empresas com melhor qualidade de alocação para seus clientes, e renovamos o selo de Integridade de Compliance e Governança para o período de 2025/26.

Descrição do Cargo

Estamos procurando Assessor de Investimentos para se juntar à nossa equipe. As tarefas diárias deste cargo incluem fornecer assessoria financeira personalizada, desenvolver e apresentar estratégias de investimentos, realizar planejamentos financeiros e manter um atendimento ao cliente de excelência. Este é um cargo de tempo integral e híbrido, permitindo que parte ou a totalidade do trabalho seja feito remotamente.   • Atendimento ao Cliente: Habilidades de atendimento ao cliente são cruciais para garantir a satisfação e fidelização do cliente.

O que oferecemos

  • Política de comissionamento acima da média do segmento .
  • Bônus semestral , vinculado à captação líquida do assessor.
  • Caso o candidato já atue como assessor , analisaremos a viabilidade de uma proposta financeira que contribua para o seu ingresso na WAY.
  • Nossa economista-chefe, Alexandre Espirito Santo , posiciona a WAY como uma das empresas com maior exposição na imprensa especializada , construindo autoridade para o Assessor junto à base de clientes e prospects.
  • Comissionamento no modelo de fee based estruturado e priorizado pela WAY.
  • Empresa com Selo de Governança e Qualidade de Compliance da XP .
  • Partnership estruturado , tornando a empresa um organismo vivo e meritocrático .
  • Equipe Operacional para atendimento ao assessor, possibilitando que dedique seu tempo ao relacionamento com seus clientes e prospects.
  • Equipe de Marketing com foco no posicionamento e fortalecimento da imagem da empresa e do Assessor.

title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Information Technology Manager role at LEDN .

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full-time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar roles in rapidly growing, security-first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code, and is excited to help end users who need assistance.

The role reports to the Director of IT and involves working closely with Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams such as Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR. This is a customer-facing, first-line support role where you own the support experience for employees via tools like Slack and Jira. We are a Mac environment.

Responsibilities

  • Be the first line of support for employees; own support experience via Slack, Jira, and related tools.
  • Administer and troubleshoot Mac endpoints; procure and deliver technology equipment; onboard new employees and retrieve equipment from departing employees.
  • Design, test, build, and document programs, policies, and tools; contribute improvements to existing knowledge.
  • Manage SaaS applications (Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro/Protect/Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.) and Mac endpoint/mobile device management tools (MDM/EMM/Jamf).
  • Improve identity and access management (IDP/SSO) integrations (GSuite, Okta).
  • Detail solutions, craft help articles, and automate routine tasks.
  • Manage, respond to, and resolve critical incidents and issues to completion; prioritize help desk tickets and balance them with project work.
  • Contribute to projects using agile methods and sprints (Jira); set and track objectives and key results aligned to team and company goals.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders across teams and maintain customer-focused IT service delivery.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration (e.g., Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite).
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, Python, and similar languages.
  • Experience with open source tools (e.g., Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki).
  • Ability to integrate SSO into Okta and create workflows in Okta; experience with APIs to integrate systems.
  • Remote support experience across multiple countries/time zones; ability to handle shipping/receiving hardware and customs.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication; ability to explain complex concepts clearly and empathetically.
  • Strong documentation skills and ability to craft clear help articles; ability to manage projects and self-direct priorities.
  • Fundamental networking knowledge and troubleshooting (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing, OSI model).
  • Self-management and ability to scope projects and coordinate across multiple teams.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills; comfortable navigating ambiguity and making decisions with incomplete data.

Nice to haves: Some familiarity with AWS; experience with GAM/command-line tools; Jamf/Okta/Google Workspace certifications.

Culture & Benefits

  • Culture fit: leadership mindset, adaptability in a startup/tech environment, collaborative across functions, and empathy in cross-cultural contexts.
  • Comprehensive total rewards package starting on day one.
  • Competitive PTO; equity ownership in the company.
  • Remote-friendly: opportunity to work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).
  • Inclusive, diverse workplace and equal opportunity employer; accommodations available during recruitment.

You may reach out for accommodation requests at any stage of the recruitment process. Requests will be addressed confidentially. We are a remote-first, globally distributed team and may contact only qualified applicants due to high application volume. No agencies or recruiters, and we do not sponsor unsolicited resumes.

title: ENFERMEIRO EMERGÊNCIA -  HOSPITAL CASA DE PORTUGAL(PJ)
description:
Resumo da vaga

Somos a Rede Hospital Casa, um dos maiores operadores médicos hospitalares independentes do estado do Rio de Janeiro. O ACOLHIMENTO COMO NOSSO JEITO DE CUIDAR está entre os nossos principais valores. Estamos em busca de um profissional para atuar como ENFERMEIRO EMERGÊNCIA , proativo, cuidadoso, dedicado e que tenha atenção e carinho com seus processos de trabalho.

Principais atividades

  • Participar e dar continuidade às atividades executadas pela Gerência e Coordenação de Enfermagem;
  • Respeitar a hierarquia do Organograma da Enfermagem e da instituição;
  • Exercer a função assistencial e administrativa, educativa, de pesquisa e social em concordância com a Gerência de Enfermagem;
  • Participar das reuniões com a Gerência de Enfermagem, CIPA, CCIH, Serviço de Educação Continuada e demais comissões instituídas na empresa/instituição;
  • Auxiliar na identificação dos fatores que favorecem e dificultam o processo de enfermagem;
  • Zelar pelas condições ambientais de segurança do setor, buscando o bem-estar da equipe interdisciplinar;
  • Solucionar intercorrências, visando um bom padrão de assistência ao cliente;
  • Atender as necessidades da equipe de enfermagem, orientando-os e supervisionando, e dos pacientes, priorizando pelo grau de dependência;
  • Fazer cumprir as normas e rotinas já existentes, incluindo as da CCIH, de acordo com os POPs;
  • Participar da passagem de plantão, leito a leito, com prontuários em ordem, incluindo itens como identificação, medicação verificada, alterações de material, exames realizados e anotações claras;
  • Realizar a cada plantão o registro no Livro de Ordens e Ocorrências, descrevendo o quantitativo de equipe, preenchendo o checklist, anotando intercorrências e informações relevantes;
  • Ler o Livro de Ocorrências diariamente;
  • Assegurar conformidade com as metas do NSP (Núcleo de Segurança do Paciente) e abrir Notificações quando houver não conformidades;
  • Realizar a admissão do paciente e evolução diária, preenchendo corretamente o SAE para pacientes que permanecerão por mais de 6 horas no setor, antes de encaminhar para internação;
  • Abordar o paciente diretamente, principalmente os mais graves, atendendo a todas as suas necessidades básicas, promovendo condições adequadas para repouso e recuperação;
  • Realizar procedimentos técnicos de maior complexidade, de competência do enfermeiro (curativos, cateterismo vesical, sondagens vesical e nasogástrica/nasoentérica), registrando tudo na evolução do paciente;
  • Aprazar a prescrição médica, obedecendo à padronização determinada e aos cuidados necessários;
  • Preparar e instalar drips, delegando para a equipe técnica apenas na presença de eventualidades;
  • Encaminhar exames e autorizar materiais especiais aos setores responsáveis, conforme protocolo;
  • Informar ao médico plantonista as intercorrências ocorridas com o paciente ou com a terapêutica adotada;
  • Atender situações de urgência e emergência, identificando sinais de deterioração clínica;
  • Chamar equipe médica e fisioterapeuta para atendimento e situações emergenciais, com o médico no acompanhamento de exames e tratamentos;
  • Dar informações ao paciente quanto à terapêutica e aos exames solicitados;
  • Certificar o uso correto da pulseira de identificação e realizar a identificação do paciente;
  • Acompanhar o paciente até o setor de Radiologia e assisti-lo durante a realização de todo o exame;
  • Supervisionar o acompanhamento do paciente até o Centro Cirúrgico, se houver necessidade de intervenção cirúrgica;
  • Acompanhar o paciente até o quarto no momento da alta para a Unidade de Internação/Centro de Terapia Intensiva, passando o plantão para o integrante da equipe de enfermagem responsável.

Perfil desejado

  • Nível superior em Enfermagem
  • Desejável experiência de 6 meses na função
  • Especialização na área de Emergência
  • Mediação de conflitos, procedimentos de enfermagem BLS, ACLS
  • Pacote Office

Benefícios

  • Refeição no Local
  • Salário R$ 4.100,00 - PJ

Horário de trabalho

Escala 12x36 SD (7h às 19h)

High School Diploma or equivalent. (Required)

Experience

3 or more years Residential Mortgage banking and closing. (Required)

Each employee of the Organization, regardless of position, is accountable for reading, understanding and acting on the contents of all Company-assigned and/or job related Compliance Programs, regulations and policies and procedures, as well as ensure that all Compliance Training assignments are completed by established due dates. Specific compensation offered will be determined based on a combination of factors including the candidate’s knowledge, skills, depth of work experience, and relevant licenses/credentials. The salary range may vary based on geographic location.

description:
Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.

GET TO KNOW US

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in 11 countries, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company.

We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally.

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Marketing Data Analyst to our Marketing B2B team in Brazil ! This is a Remote – Brazil position, meaning you can work from anywhere within the country. Please note that this role is only open to candidates in Brazil.

The Marketing Data Analyst is an embedded analyst position that plays a key role in transforming marketing data into dashboards and reports that drive strategic decisions across marketing initiatives. This role's primary responsibility is to support Insights Managers by preparing clean, accurate, and repeatable data assets and reports. The analyst will transform business questions and challenges into queries and dashboards, ensuring that the data product ecosystem is robust and consistent for others to consume. This key player shapes marketing strategy through targeted data products, identifying opportunities for improvement and collaborating across teams to enable data-driven insights.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Data Preparation: Translate business or insight questions into queries, reports, and/or dashboards, and collaborate with Insights Managers on how we want to give visibility to this data (understanding the “why” and the business challenge)
  • Dashboard Creation: Build and maintain reports and dashboards to monitor performance metrics.
  • Data Governance: Ensure the consistent usage of concepts, metrics, and KPI definitions across our data products.
  • Quality Testing: Ensure data accuracy and reliability in our dashboards by proactively detecting possible data deviations and working with Analytics Engineers to resolve them. Develop new business quality tests for new data products.
  • Ecosystem Collaboration: Collaborate with the Global Analytics team to ensure a robust data product ecosystem and consistent reporting methodologies.
  • Stakeholder Relationship: Collaborate closely with Insights Managers and business stakeholders to understand their needs and ensure analytics deliverables align with their objectives.
  • Live the mission: Inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Degree in Marketing Analytics, Business Intelligence, Data Analytics, or related fields.
  • Previous experience with Marketing Analytics, Business Intelligence or Data Science.
  • Proficiency in BI and visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI, Looker, Amplitude).
  • Advanced knowledge in SQL and/or Python for data analysis and exploration.
  • Preferred knowledge of marketing technology platforms such as Hubspot, SFMC, Braze, or Segment.
  • Understanding of marketing concepts and user journeys.
  • Strong storytelling and data presentations skills.
  • Advanced English is mandatory.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don’t match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience with Tableau, Metabase, Python or SQL and advanced english are mandatory requirements.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life.

Our flexible benefits program allows you to customize some of the benefits, according to your needs!

Our benefits include:

WELLHUB: Free Gold+ membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.

WELLZ: A complete emotional wellbeing program with a unique approach. It offers personalized journeys that combine individual therapy sessions (52 per year) and on-demand content.

HEALTHCARE: Health, dental, and life insurance.

FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. When you join, use our home office reimbursement to set up your home office.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Flexibility for us isn’t just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.

PAID TIME OFF: It’s important to take time away from work to recharge. Employees receive vacations after 6 months and additional 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + an extra holiday for your birthday!

PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled.

CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions, build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success.

CULTURE: You’ll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters.

title: Finance Transformation Automation Associate
description:
Finance Transformation Automation Associate

Join to apply for the Finance Transformation Automation Associate role at dLocal

Overview

dLocal enables the biggest companies in the world to collect payments in 40 countries in emerging markets. Global brands rely on us to increase conversion rates and simplify payment expansion effortlessly. As both a payments processor and a merchant of record where we operate, we make it possible for our merchants to make inroads into the world’s fastest-growing, emerging markets. By joining us you will be part of an amazing global team that makes it all happen, in a flexible, remote-first dynamic culture with travel, health and learning benefits, among others. Being part of dLocal means working with 1000+ teammates from 30+ nationalities and developing an international career that impacts millions of people’s daily lives.

What’s the opportunity?

  • We are seeking a Finance Transformation Automation Associate to drive the automation of financial and operational reconciliations. This role involves integrating data sources from banks and processors (APIs, SFTP, email), standardizing controls, and systematizing variance analysis to accelerate closes and reduce rework. The role blends financial–operational knowledge with skills in data ingestion services, and secure connectivity to move and validate data at scale. Success requires strong proficiency in Excel, familiarity with SQL and Python, and a strong focus on continuous improvement in an agile, fast-paced environment.

What will I be doing?

  • Integrate and maintain data sources from banks/processors via APIs, SFTP, and email workflows, ensuring data quality, completeness, and traceability
  • Execute and improve reconciliation controls for the different types of transactions supported by dashboards, matching rules, and audit evidence
  • Prepare and cleanse inputs (reconcilable groups, rules, sweeps), coordinating adjustments and new implementations with responsible teams
  • Analyze variances and differences across banks, processors, and internal records; conduct root-cause analysis and propose remedial actions and automation solutions
  • Develop analytical models (pivot tables, lookups; Power Query/Power Pivot, or equivalent) for KPIs, variance monitoring, and control tracking
  • Manage tickets and workflows in Jira for new reconciliations, rule/sweep changes, file uploads/removals, following strong documentation practices
  • Collaborate with Business Assurance, Operations, Treasury, Accounting, Product, and Data to resolve incidents, capture requirements, and coordinate UAT for new integrations
  • Standardize SOPs, strengthen controls, and scale end-to-end automations to reduce manual work, and rework during closes
  • Support multiple projects simultaneously in an agile context: gathering requirements, coordinating with stakeholders, performing UAT, and managing change

What skills do I need?

  • 2-4+ years in Finance Transformation, Treasury, Finance Operations, Engineering, or Process Automation, ideally within payments, fintech, or banking
  • Advanced Excel proficiency
  • Experience with SQL, Python and automation, with a track record of implementing tech-driven solutions
  • Experience with data ingestion and secure connectivity: APIs, SFTP, CSV/JSON; familiarity with VPN and SSH keys
  • Experience with BI/reporting tools (e.g., Looker, Power BI) is a plus
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving ability, ability to context-switch across multiple projects
  • Growth mindset with high adaptability, comfort with change, and an agile way of working
  • Excellent documentation and organizational skills
  • Fluent in spoken and written English

What do we offer?

  • Remote work: work from anywhere or one of our offices around the globe*
  • Flexibility: flexible schedules and performance-driven culture
  • Fintech industry: dynamic environment with opportunities to build and boost creativity
  • Referral bonus program: employees can refer candidates and earn rewards
  • Learning & development: Premium Coursera subscription
  • Language classes: free English, Spanish, or Portuguese classes
  • Social budget: monthly budget to engage with your team
  • dLocal Houses: option to rent a house and work remotely with your team
  • Location note: for Montevideo-based roles, attendance requirement at the office is 55% (not applicable to IT and Fraud roles)

What happens after you apply?

Our Talent Acquisition team will keep you posted by email at every step of the process.

Additional information

For more about dLocal, check our webpage, LinkedIn, Instagram, and YouTube.

We are seeking a Finance & FP&A Analyst to join our leadership team.   • Proficiency in QuickBooks Online, Google Suite, Microsoft Suite, and spreadsheet modeling.

  • Alignment with LunaJoy’s values: Wolf Mentality, 1% Better, Resilient & Resourceful, Customers Determine Our Success, Speed is a Habit, Give & Get Joy.
  • Nice To Haves
  • CPA, CFA, or equivalent financial certification.
  • Prior experience leading finance in a venture-backed healthcare company.
  • Exposure to AI and automation in finance or compliance functions.
  • Experience in M&A integration and investor relations.

Why LunaJoy?

  • Mission-Driven Purpose: Directly contribute to improving access to mental health care for women.

We are remote-first and support a diverse, global team.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full-time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate will wear many hats, including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. You will participate in the design, implementation and management of our growing cloud-first infrastructure and networks. You should be passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code, and be able to adapt to a fast-moving, security-first environment. This role reports to the Director of IT.

You will be customer-facing and the first line of support, owning the employee tech experience via Slack, Jira, and other tools. Responsibilities include procuring and delivering technology equipment, onboarding new employees, and provisioning tech for outgoing staff. You will design, test, build, and document programs, policies, and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge bases. You will support and manage SaaS applications (Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro/Protect/Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.) and manage Mac endpoints and MDM/EMM tools. You will also work on identity and access management (IDP/SSO with G Suite, Okta), document solutions, and automate routine tasks.

You will manage incidents, prioritize help desk tickets, and collaborate across teams (Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering, HR). You will work in sprints with Jira and align your objectives and key results with team and company goals.

Responsibilities

  • Provide end-user support and own the employee tech experience (Mac-centric environment).
  • Procure and deliver technology equipment; own onboarding and offboarding hardware responsibilities.
  • Design, test, build, and document IT programs and policies; contribute to knowledge bases.
  • Manage SaaS applications: Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro/Protect/Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.
  • Manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management (MDM/EMM) tools (Jamf, etc.).
  • Improve IDP and SSO tooling (GSuite, Okta); integrate systems via APIs.
  • Troubleshoot, respond to incidents, and manage help desk tickets with prioritization.
  • Participate in project work over sprints with Agile practices (Jira).
  • Set and pursue own objectives and key results aligned with company goals.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration (Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite).
  • Ability to create automations using Bash, Zsh, Python, etc.; familiarity with open-source tools (Nudge, CIS benchmarks, Munki, etc.).
  • Experience integrating SSO and workflows in Okta; API experience for system integrations.
  • Remote support experience across multiple countries/time zones; shipping and receiving hardware experience.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to explain complex concepts clearly and empathetically.
  • Strong security consciousness and understanding of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs) and OSI model troubleshooting.
  • Self-management: ability to scope projects, prioritize, and work across multiple teams.

Nice to Have / Culture Fit

  • Familiarity with AWS; experience with GAM and command-line interfaces.
  • Jamf or Okta certifications; Google Workspace certifications.
  • Experience in a remote, high-growth startup or tech environment; collaborative, empathetic partner across functions.

Benefits & Environment

  • Comprehensive total rewards package and equity opportunities.
  • Remote-friendly with up to 180 days of remote work worldwide (subject to restrictions).
  • Inclusive, diverse workplace with equal opportunity employment principles.

Equal Opportunity

We are an equal opportunity employment organization and pride ourselves on inclusivity, diversity, and the success that comes from diversity. You may reach out to the Ledn team for accommodation requests during all stages of the recruitment process. Requests will be addressed confidentially.

Ledn’s team is global and remote-first; short-listed candidates may be asked to submit a short video response and public social media activity relevant to the role. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes or fees.

Nos primeiros passos no esporte, na velocidade das pistas de corrida, nas manobras de skate, na agilidade das chuteiras em campo, no lifestyle de quem se veste de esporte dos pés à cabeça. Contamos com um time de mais de 1.000 colaboradores, que vestem a camisa com orgulho e representam não apenas uma marca, mas o compromisso de transformar a vida dos brasileiros por meio da alegria e paixão pelo esporte.

A pessoa que ocupa a função de Consultor de Vendas é a peça chave do nosso time, pois o campo tem que estar organizado para o jogo acontecer! É a pessoa que vai encantar o nosso cliente e garantir uma experiência inesquecível em nossa loja.

  • Habilidade com organização e reposição de produtos
  • Disponibilidade de horário (período tarde/noite)
  • Vontade de aprender e de crescer

Para nós, esporte é mais que só a prática: é movimento. Ele tem o poder de mover as pessoas pelo exercício, pela paixão pelo time do coração, pela diversão de uma aula de dança, pela força de marcas icônicas.

Por vermos a potência do esporte em todas as suas expressões, trabalhamos juntos com garra e energia para construir o primeiro ecossistema de esporte do mundo, reunindo diversas possibilidades para que as pessoas sejam envolvidas e impactadas pelo poder de se movimentar.

Quando você pensar em esporte, pode ter certeza: o Grupo SBF estará ali. Seja por meio das lojas e do e-commerce da Centauro, a maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina; da Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no Brasil, da FitDance e da OneFan, aqui o movimento não para.

Praticante ou entusiasta, fã ou apaixonado: o Grupo SBF é pra você. Somos saudavelmente inconformados, fazedores e convictos da importância de levar o movimento para cada vez mais gente.

Se você se move por esporte, ou é movido por ele, temos um convite: que tal também trabalhar por ele?

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Cumprir as rotinas determinados pela a área de Enfermagem, quando referente ao acompanhamento e condução de pacientes.

Experiência mínima de 06 meses na função

Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores e/ou prestadores de serviços, vínculo com grau de parentesco ou afinidade no mesmo serviço ou que atuam em outra modalidade contratual (vínculo com o prestador), deverão observar normativas de RH vigentes, através de consulta junto ao setor de Recrutamento e Seleção.

Nos primeiros passos no esporte, na velocidade das pistas de corrida, nas manobras de skate, na agilidade das chuteiras em campo, no lifestyle de quem se veste de esporte dos pés à cabeça. Contamos com um time de mais de 1.000 colaboradores, que vestem a camisa com orgulho e representam não apenas uma marca, mas o compromisso de transformar a vida dos brasileiros por meio da alegria e paixão pelo esporte.

A pessoa que ocupa a função de Consultor de Vendas é a peça chave do nosso time, pois o campo tem que estar organizado para o jogo acontecer! É a pessoa que vai encantar o nosso cliente e garantir uma experiência inesquecível em nossa loja.

Para nós, esporte é mais que só a prática: é movimento. Ele tem o poder de mover as pessoas pelo exercício, pela paixão pelo time do coração, pela diversão de uma aula de dança, pela força de marcas icônicas.

Por vermos a potência do esporte em todas as suas expressões, trabalhamos juntos com garra e energia para construir o primeiro ecossistema de esporte do mundo, reunindo diversas possibilidades para que as pessoas sejam envolvidas e impactadas pelo poder de se movimentar.

Quando você pensar em esporte, pode ter certeza: o Grupo SBF estará ali. Seja por meio das lojas e do e-commerce da Centauro, a maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina; da Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no Brasil, da FitDance e da OneFan, aqui o movimento não para.

Praticante ou entusiasta, fã ou apaixonado: o Grupo SBF é pra você. Somos saudavelmente inconformados, fazedores e convictos da importância de levar o movimento para cada vez mais gente.

Se você se move por esporte, ou é movido por ele, temos um convite: que tal também trabalhar por ele?
