title: Marketplace Manager
description:
About the Job


Draiver is an industry-leading self-learning logistics platform that enables vehicle movement planning, coordination, and execution. We connect businesses to transport services and independent contract drivers, providing GPS routing, tracking, digital documentation, and payment solutions in one simple application. Our platform empowers companies to streamline operations while drivers gain flexible access to opportunities.


We are looking for a Marketplace Manager to play a pivotal role at the intersection of operations and product. This person will oversee the growth and health of our driver marketplace, ensuring we deliver the best experience for drivers and partners, while collaborating closely with product and engineering to shape platform improvements.


This is a unique opportunity to manage dynamic multi-country markets, drive measurable business impact, and influence the roadmap of a global gig-economy platform.


What You’ll Do



  • Own marketplace performance across supply and demand, identifying opportunities to improve driver engagement, retention, and efficiency.

  • Work cross-functionally with product, operations, data, and business development teams to design and execute strategies that scale sustainably.

  • Collaborate with product management to define requirements and prioritize features that improve marketplace balance, transparency, and user experience.

  • Launch and optimize new markets, setting up operational frameworks, KPIs, and success metrics.

  • Monitor performance data to detect trends, identify bottlenecks, and recommend improvements to driver onboarding, trip allocation, pricing, and compliance processes.

  • Act as a bridge between marketplace realities and product development, ensuring product decisions are informed by operational insights.

  • Build business cases for new initiatives and drive projects end-to-end, from ideation to execution.

  • Partner with local teams and leadership across the US, Brazil, Mexico, Canada, and other markets to align strategies and share best practices.


Basic Qualifications



  • Bachelor’s degree in business, economics, engineering, computer science, or a related field.

  • 3+ years of experience in marketplace operations, product management, consulting, or a similar data-driven role.

  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to structure problems, interpret data, and translate insights into action.

  • Experience working with cross-functional teams in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

  • Excellent communication and influencing skills, with the ability to work across countries and cultures.

  • Hands-on mentality with resilience, adaptability, and a bias toward execution.

  • Proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets (pivot tables, lookups, charts) and comfort with data tools.


Bonus Points If



  • You have direct experience managing a two-sided marketplace or gig economy platform.

  • You have technical skills in SQL, Python, or dashboarding tools (e.g. Superset).

  • You bring product management or product operations experience, especially in defining requirements and working with engineering/design teams.

  • You have working proficiency in Spanish or Portuguese.


Why Join Draiver


At Draiver, you’ll be at the core of a global company that is transforming vehicle logistics. You’ll gain exposure to multiple markets, work with a diverse international team, and directly shape the evolution of our platform. This role is perfect for someone who thrives in ambiguity, loves solving complex marketplace challenges, and wants to grow as both a business and product leader.

  • Domínio de Figma (auto-layout, variants, design tokens) e boas práticas de handoff para Engenharia.
  • Vivência com Design System em produto vivo (versionamento, contribuição e gestão de estados críticos).
  • Capacidade de demonstrar impacto de design no negócio por meio de evidências objetivas de “antes/depois”.
  • Familiaridade com DesignOps (ritmos, governança, critérios de qualidade) e condução de críticas de design.
  • Conhecimento aplicado de acessibilidade (WCAG 2.2 AA).
  • Comunicação clara para articular trade-offs com Produto e Tecnologia e defender decisões de forma estruturada.

Diferenciais

We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. Through our products & services, we can make a difference in the lives and futures of our clients - in real terms. Our team at Ledn is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds. What we all have in common is an unshakeable conviction that digital assets can democratize access to the global economy and Ledn's suite of products & services can play a critical role in doing so. The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. Combining these values with our conviction make Ledn an unstoppable force in changing the world for the better. Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services!

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar role(s) in rapidly growing, security-first, environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code. You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud first infrastructure and networks. You will have a passion for innovation and creative problem solving, as well as be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment. You will need to be a highly motivated, dependable and an experienced technologist who shares our passion and wants to be a part of a fast moving and highly execution-oriented team. You will work closely with your Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams, including, but not limited to, Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR. The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner who is looking for a supportive environment to continue to grow their IT skills and expertise. This role will report to the Director of IT.

About the Role

You will be customer-facing, and the first line of support; you own support, and you are passionate about providing an outstanding support experience to our employees — via Slack, Jira, etc. We're all Mac. You are a pro at troubleshooting, using the terminal, and making macOS work in the enterprise. You will be responsible for procuring and delivering technology equipment. You will own the experience of tech onboarding of all new employees as well as tech retrieval of all outgoing employees. You'll design, test, build, and document programs and policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge with your experience and background. You'll support and manage SaaS applications — Google Workspace (GSuite), Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, etc. You will work with and manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools — MDM, EMM, Jamf, etc. You'll own and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.) You’ll detail your solutions, craft help articles and automate busywork. Manage, respond to, and fix critical incidents and issues as needed, through to completion. You’ll juggle help desk tickets and prioritise them. You’ll work on projects over sprints, and detail your work in tools like Jira (you’re experienced with agile methods and sprints). You’ll set and work to your own objective and key results with minimal direction, and can align them to the team and the company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc.
  • Ability to utilize open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • You are able to integrate SSO into Okta, create workflows in Okta.
  • You know how to work with APIs, and integrate one system to another.
  • You’ve provided remote support to people in multiple countries, across time zones, and you're familiar with shipping and receiving hardware and customs.
  • unusually great communication skills across all media — you can make your ideas clear, and you can help people who might be frustrated or time poor without losing your cool. You write very well, whether it's in tickets, email or Slack.
  • You write in a clear, friendly, and concise manner, and are sensitive to different cultures. A desire to provide a magical experience for others — when they win, you win. You take security seriously, and you know what PGP is. You understand networking fundamentals and basic troubleshooting — TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching. You must be able to competently and demonstrably know the troubleshooting steps and layers of the OSI model — you know how to methodically troubleshoot problems without wasting someone's time. You can self-manage, and can accurately scope your project, priorities, and work across multiple teams.

Nice to Haves

  • Some familiarity with AWS (not required to be certified).
  • You have used tools like GAM and command-line interfaces to do lots of work with less effort.
  • Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.

Culture Fit

We’re looking for more than just operational excellence — we want a leader who thrives in the startup or tech environment and embodies our values.

The ideal candidate will

  • Have a passion for progress by being adaptable and resilient, and is comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high-growth, fast-paced environment.
  • Have a builder's mindset, excited to create, iterate, and scale IT practices.
  • Be a collaborative partner, able to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity.
  • Demonstrate integrity and accountability, especially in managing confidential information across diverse legal and cultural contexts.
  • Have worked in a remote environment before.

A Taste of What We Provide

As one of the world's leading digital asset companies, we provide tremendous growth opportunities. Comprehensive, best-in-class total rewards package that starts on your first day!

  • We offer a competitive PTO package that ensures you have the time off you deserve. Ownership in the company.
  • Through shared equity, Ledn employees are stakeholders in the company and the future of the digital economy.
  • We offer every employee the opportunity to work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).
  • A career that provides you with purpose in your job. We remove barriers so you love what you do.

We are an equal opportunity employment organization and pride ourselves on inclusivity, diversity, and the success that comes from diversity. You may reach out to the Ledn team by emailing ****** for accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process. Requests will be addressed confidentially.

Ledn Working Environment

Our Ledn team is truly global in nature with our people spanning across North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe. We are a remote first environment. Please note, due to the high volume of applications, only those applicants that qualify will be contacted. As part of our selection process, shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response and we may review publicly available social media activity relevant to the role. No agencies or recruiters please. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and we are not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Senior Product Designer to lead the design of a new, high-impact product within our growing mobility platform. This role blends UX strategy, visual design, and product thinking—from user research and usability testing to building intuitive, production-ready interfaces in Figma. You’ll collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, and designers, helping shape a cohesive design system and elevating the overall product experience. This position offers the opportunity to work in a startup-paced environment, where your ideas will directly influence product direction and user satisfaction.

  • Design from Discovery to Delivery: Conduct user research and usability testing, translate insights into wireframes and prototypes, and ship elegant, production-ready designs.
  • Own the Visual System: Create scalable, consistent design components in Figma, contributing to and expanding our design system.
  • Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Partner with product managers, engineers, and other designers to define problems, explore solutions, and iterate quickly.
  • Champion the User: Bring a user-first mindset to ensure designs are functional, accessible, and visually cohesive across platforms.
  • Contribute to Culture: Collaborate with the broader design team (4+ designers plus UX lead) to evolve design standards, processes, and best practices.

  • Product Mindset: Proven success designing within software development environments, collaborating closely with engineers and PMs.

  • Portfolio Quality: Work that demonstrates polished, interaction-focused design for complex digital products.
  • Communication: Excellent English skills (written and spoken).
  • Work Ethic: Startup mentality — proactive, adaptable, and able to thrive in a fast-paced environment.
  • Nice-to-Have: Experience designing for B2B, logistics, or other complex system-driven products.

Global Benefits & Perks at CharterUP

  • Remote-First Flexibility: Work from anywhere we hire, with built-in flexibility. U.S.-based employees may reside in any of our 19 approved states.
  • Comprehensive Health & Wellness: Medical, dental, and vision insurance, mental health support, virtual care, gym discounts, and family-building benefits. In the U.S., we cover 100% of premiums for employees. International benefits align with local standards.
  • Time Off to Recharge: Paid time off so you can truly unplug. U.S.: 15 PTO days (increasing to 20 after 2 years) + 8 paid holidays. International policies vary by country.
  • Financial Peace of Mind: Company-paid life, short-term, and long-term disability insurance where available.
  • Performance-Driven Culture: Join a fast-moving, ambitious, and collaborative team that wins together.
  • Referral Rewards: Earn bonuses for bringing top talent to the team.
  • Planning for the Future: Long-term financial planning support. U.S.: 401(k) plan. International: region-specific savings programs where applicable.
  • Top-Tier Tech: Choose a Mac or PC, plus monitor, keyboard, and mouse to hit the ground running.

Aqui, cada pessoa, seja cliente, líder ou colega, desempenha um papel essencial no nosso sucesso coletivo.

Na Qive, estamos comprometidos em mudar a forma como o mercado se relaciona com Documentos Fiscais Eletrônicos (DFes), reduzindo horas operacionais, conomizando custos e mitigando riscos. Nossa cultura é orientada pela inovação, responsabilidade e agilidade, sempre com o objetivo de liderar o mercado e oferecer soluções que impulsionem o crescimento de nossos clientes.

Venha fazer parte dessa revolução e seja o nosso elo para ajudar a construir um futuro mais simples e descomplicado para as empresas brasileiras!

Responsabilidades e objetivos da vaga

  • Estruturar e Executar o Plano de Auditoria Integrada: Mapear processos ponta a ponta (financeiros, operacionais e de TI) para avaliar a adequação e a eficácia dos controles internos com base nos frameworks COSO (controles internos) e COBIT (governança de TI), com foco especial nos fluxos transacionais e de configuração operados no SAP B1.
  • Conduzir Testes de Controles e Substantivos: Desenvolver e executar programas de testes de auditoria para avaliar a integridade dos registros contábeis e a segurança dos sistemas de informação. Isso inclui a condução de testes de Controles Gerais de TI (ITGCs), a validação da conformidade das configurações e a análise de dados para identificar anomalias.
  • Reportar Achados e Acompanhar Planos de Ação: Elaborar relatórios de auditoria claros e objetivos, comunicando as deficiências identificadas, os riscos associados e as recomendações de melhoria para a alta gestão. Atuar em parceria com as áreas de negócio para desenvolver e acompanhar a implementação dos planos de ação.
  • Atuar como Consultor de Riscos e Controles: Servir como um consultor interno para as áreas de negócio e tecnologia, oferecendo suporte na análise de riscos de novos projetos, processos e sistemas, garantindo que os controles sejam desenhados de forma eficaz desde a concepção (compliance and security by design).

Requisitos

  • Experiência Híbrida em Auditoria: Sólida experiência em auditoria interna ou externa, com vivência comprovada tanto em auditoria de processos contábeis e financeiros (ciclo de receita, despesas, fechamento) quanto em auditoria de sistemas e Controles Gerais de TI (ITGC).
  • Domínio de Frameworks de Controle: Profundo conhecimento teórico e prático nos frameworks de controle interno e governança de TI, especialmente COSO (Estrutura Integrada de Controles Internos) e COBIT (para processos de TI).
  • Conhecimento em ERP e Processos Contábeis: Excelente base de conhecimento contábil (princípios, conciliações, relatórios) e experiência prática com sistemas ERP, com destaque para o SAP B1, entendendo seus módulos, tabelas e fluxos de dados.
  • Perfil Analítico e Comunicação Efetiva: Perfil crítico, detalhista e com alta capacidade analítica para conectar informações de diferentes fontes e identificar a causa raiz dos problemas. Habilidade de comunicação para apresentar achados complexos de forma clara para públicos técnicos e não técnicos.

Pontos a mais se você possui

  • Habilidades em Análise de Dados (CAATs): Domínio de ferramentas e linguagens para Testes de Auditoria Assistidos por Computador, como bancos de dados SQL para extração e manipulação de grandes volumes de informação e Python para automação de testes e análises.
  • Conhecimento em Normas Contábeis Específicas: Familiaridade com planos de contas setoriais, como o COSIF, e conhecimento em regulamentações de privacidade de dados (LGPD) e segurança da informação (ISO 27001).
  • Certificações Profissionais: Possuir certificações na área de auditoria, como CIA (Certified Internal Auditor), CISA (Certified Information Systems Auditor) ou outras correlatas.

Benefícios

  • Plano de saúde Unimed com cobertura nacional, sem desconto de mensalidade ou coparticipação para nossos Qivers e seus filhos;
  • Plano odontológico com cobertura nacional, sem descontos em folha e possibilidade de inclusão de filhos, parentes, pais e sogros;
  • Benefício Flash Flex com um valor bem competitivo, aceito em restaurantes, supermercados, padarias, mobilidade, bem-estar, saúde, educação, cultura e entretenimento, sem nenhum desconto;
  • Se nós crescemos, nossos Qivers também vem com a gente! Temos um Programa de Participação nos Resultados da empresa (PPR) competitivo com o mercado;
  • Licença maternidade e paternidade estendidas, inclusive para adoção e casais homoafetivos;
  • Ajuda de custo ao qiver nos 03 primeiros meses após o nascimento ou adoção no valor de R$ 1.000,00 avançados;
  • Auxílio creche ou babá para filhos de até 06 anos de idade;
  • Total Pass;
  • Cartão Alelo Multibenefícios;
  • Seguro de vida.

E mais

  • Trabalho remoto, liberdade geográfica em qualquer lugar do país;
  • Enviamos todos os equipamentos necessários para montar o seu escritório em casa, mas se você preferir temos uma sede com estacionamento gratuito, lanches e bebidas liberadas e um ambiente super descontraído.
  • Ambiente de aprendizado e desenvolvimento constante, incentivando o crescimento individual, feedbacks e trabalho em equipe;
  • Valorizamos o bem-estar, por isso temos aulas online e gratuitas de Yoga, Meditação e Ginástica Laboral;
  • Pensando na saúde mental e no desenvolvimento, também temos parceiros como Ana Health, Vamos Escrever e Cambly.

Diversidade é aprendizado e inclusão é necessária na Qive

Estamos em constante aprendizado para garantir que todas as pessoas possuam liberdade e respeito para falar e ouvir e sentir em seu dia a dia as experiências positivas apresentadas pela Qive! Isso é mais do que resolver uma dor em comum, queremos ser melhores sempre, queremos mudar o jogo seja ele qual for. E contamos com você para fazer a diferença e isso independe de sua crença, gênero, orientação sexual, cor de pele, deficiência ou classe social.

Privacidade dos Dados Pessoais

Em nossos processos seletivos coletamos e tratamos os dados pessoais fornecidos no formulário de candidatura da vaga (o que inclui tanto os dados informados em cada campo do formulário, quanto os que estiverem presentes no currículo anexado) e dados que podem ser solicitados nas próximas etapas. A Qive não terá acesso a nenhum outro dado que esteja fora destas hipóteses. A finalidade de coleta é tão somente para identificação, comunicação e análise das pessoas candidatas.

Informamos ainda que realizamos toda a gestão das vagas por meio do sistema InHire, não possuindo vínculo com outras plataformas em que as nossas vagas são espelhadas. Logo, caso você esteja se candidatando às nossas vagas por um meio que não seja o nosso site oficial ou pela InHire, recomenda-se a leitura dos termos e políticas próprias de cada um.

Em caso de dúvidas sobre dados pessoais, entre em contato através dos meios informados em nossa Política de Privacidade.

Overview

Join to apply for the Information Technology Manager role at LEDN .

The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. Ledn aims to be an unstoppable force in changing the world for the better. Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full-time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many hats, including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar roles in rapidly growing, security-first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and infrastructure as code, and is excited to help end users who need assistance.

You will participate in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud-first infrastructure and networks. You will be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment and work closely with Cybersecurity/IT peers and stakeholder teams (Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR). The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner seeking a supportive environment to grow IT skills and expertise. This role reports to the Director of IT.

About the Role

You will be customer-facing and the first line of support; you own support and are passionate about providing an outstanding experience to employees via Slack, Jira, etc. We are primarily Mac environments. You will procure and deliver technology equipment and manage tech onboarding for new employees and tech retrieval for departing employees.

You will design, test, build, and document programs, policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge. You will support and manage SaaS applications such as Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro/Protect/Connect, Okta, Jira, etc. You will manage Mac endpoints and mobile device management tools (MDM/EMM) and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta). You will create solution documentation and automation to reduce manual work. You will manage incidents and tickets, prioritize workload, and participate in projects over sprints using Jira and agile methods. You will set objectives and key results aligned with team and company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn: 7+ years in SaaS systems administration (Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite). Automation skills (bash, zsh, python). Experience with open source tools (Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.). Ability to integrate SSO into Okta, create workflows, and work with APIs to connect systems. Remote support across multiple countries/time zones; familiarity with hardware shipping and customs. Excellent written and verbal communication across media. Ability to draft clear tickets, emails, and Slack messages. Comfort with security principles and basic networking (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing, OSI model). Self-management with the ability to scope work and coordinate across teams. Strong organizational and task-management skills; comfort with ambiguity.

Nice to Have: Some familiarity with AWS; experience with GAM and command-line interfaces; certifications (Jamf, Okta, Google Workspace). Culture fit: leadership mindset, adaptability, empathy, and a collaborative approach in a remote, fast-paced environment.

What We Provide

Comprehensive total rewards package, remote-friendly with up to 180 days remote eligibility (subject to restrictions); ownership in the company through equity; a purpose-driven career; inclusive, diverse, and equal opportunity employer. We welcome accommodation requests via email for recruitment process stages; responses are confidential.

Company and Hiring Notes

Ledn’s team is global, remote-first, with presence across North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe. Due to high volume of applications, only qualified applicants will be contacted. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response; we may review publicly available social media relevant to the role. No agencies or recruiters please. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and are not responsible for fees related to unsolicited resumes.

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT. This role reports to the Director of IT and is customer-facing, serving as the first line of support for employees via channels such as Slack and Jira. You will own the end-user experience, provisioning and delivering technology equipment, onboarding new employees, and offboarding with secure offboarding procedures. You’ll design, test, build, document programs and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge bases. You will manage SaaS applications (Google Workspace, Slack, Jira, Jamf Pro/Protect/Connect, Okta, etc.), Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools, and IDP/SSO integrations.

You will collaborate with Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams (Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering, HR) and work in an environment that values automation, rapid iteration, and strong communication. You will set and pursue objectives and key results aligned to team and company goals, with minimal direction.

Responsibilities

  • Provide end-user support and own help desk tickets; troubleshoot using the terminal and macOS in an enterprise setting.
  • Procure, deliver, and manage technology equipment; own onboarding and offboarding experiences for employees.
  • Design, test, build, document programs and tools; contribute improvements to knowledge bases.
  • Manage SaaS applications (Google Workspace, Slack, Jira, Jamf Pro/Protect/Connect, Okta, etc.) and Mac/Mobile Device Management tooling (MDM/EMM, Jamf).
  • Manage identity and access via IDP/SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.) and integrate systems using APIs.
  • Respond to and resolve incidents; prioritize and manage tickets with agile methods and Jira.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams and communicate clearly across multiple channels and cultures.
  • Define, document, and automate IT processes; contribute to security-minded, scalable infrastructure.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration (Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite).
  • Ability to create automations using bash/zsh/python and to utilize open-source tools (Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.).
  • Experience integrating SSO into Okta and building workflows; strong API skills and cross-system integrations.
  • Remote support experience across multiple countries/time zones; strong communication and documentation skills.
  • Proficiency with networking fundamentals, OSI model troubleshooting, and enterprise macOS management.
  • Self-management with the ability to scope projects, prioritize, and collaborate across teams.

Nice to Have

  • Some familiarity with AWS; experience with GAM and command-line interfaces; Jamf/Okta/Google Workspace certifications.
  • Culture fit: thrives in startup/tech environments; adaptable, resilient, and value-driven.

What We Provide

description:
MÉDICO CIRURGIÃO GERAL - HOSPITAL MUNICIPAL PEDRO II

Job type: Full-time employee Full-time employee

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Prestar atendimento aos pacientes de acordo com a demanda, efetuando, exame físico e hipótese diagnóstica, encaminhando o paciente a exames complementares quando necesario e realizando os procedimentos cirúrgicos indicados, zelando pela conduta e atuação dentro do princípio ético da profissão.

Ensino Superior completo em Medicina

Residência Médica ou Título de Especialista na área

  • Step 3: Avaliação 3 Avaliação

ASPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas,Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Assim, a SPDM contribui de forma efetiva para a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados pelo Sistema Único de Saúde do Brasil, visando principalmente garantir a universalidade e as oportunidades de acesso à saúde, necessárias ao desenvolvimento humano e social do cidadão. Para tanto, associa o melhor da tecnologia com atendimento médico de alta qualidade, respaldado por equipes multiprofissionais, formadas por enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêuticos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos, bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas, entre outros.

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades no ano de 2001 no município de São Paulo, se estendendo para outros municípios e estados. Desde o início de suas atividades, oPAIS busca, em parceria com a gestão pública, o crescimento e a consolidação dos serviços de saúde ofertados aos usuários do SUS.

O Programa tem como objetivo garantir mudanças nos indicadores e na qualidade de vida da população, pautado, entre outros, pelos princípios da integralidade e da equidade, com uma visão estratégica da gestão dos serviços de saúde, definida em um processo de aprimoramento contínuo.

Inclusão

A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira, para pessoas com deficiência. Para tanto, periodicamente publica anúncio recrutando esses profissionais, nos principais jornais de São Paulo e dos municípios em que se localizam suas unidades.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas com a gestão pública, em benefício da população de forma ética e humanizada, qualidade técnica, com compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, abrangendo todos os níveis da assistência, garantindo atendimento com qualidade à população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

title: Senior Drilling Engineer
description:
Join to apply for the Senior Drilling Engineer role at bp

Sub-Discipline: Engineering

Specialism: Engineering – Senior Drilling Engineer

Primary Reporting: Wells Discipline Lead

Role Synopsis

The Senior Drilling Engineer (SDE) will be responsible for engineering activities to efficiently design, plan, and support execution of wells in Brazil in accordance with all local laws and bp practices. The SDE will work with a multi-disciplinary and international team to ensure safe delivery of all business objectives for the wells. This includes addressing safety and operational risks, progressing engineering work and procedures through assurance steps, providing engineering support to the Wells Superintendent (WSUP), and mentoring less experienced staff.

Essential Role Requirements

Experience: Significant drilling engineering experience, preferably in deepwater with an operator. Experience working within, and preferably supervising, multi-disciplinary teams.

Qualifications: Excellent communication skills with the ability to communicate at all levels to efficiently manage multi-disciplinary scopes of work.

Valid Well Control Certificate (WellSharp or IWCF)

BOSIET or HUET training for locations requiring helicopter transit to the Wellsite.

Education: Bachelor in an Engineering field or higher.

Fluent in English. Fluent in Portuguese.

Key Accountabilities & Responsibilities

In this role the SDE will:

  • Provide engineering experience and expertise for well design, well planning, and preparation of wells programs that safely and compliantly conform to well objectives, leading these activities through assurance (e.g., tubular design, cementing and fluids design, well placement design, AFE preparation, risk register management, equipment readiness, program readiness).
  • Support the WSUP and Operations Team before and during the execution of wells by delivering high level drilling engineering leadership, support, and assurance.
  • Provide leadership for the day-to-day management of drilling operations and be accountable for aspects of performance (HSSE, People Agenda, and Financial Delivery) from planning to implementation and assurance.
  • Continually review drilling operations performance, identify lessons learned, and lead continuous improvement in performance and process optimisation in line with function practices and policies.
  • Identify and share global and local takeaways through collaboration with key internal partners and develop themes from issues and incidents, codifying related lessons into standards and technical practices.
  • Identify, mitigate, document, and convey wells safety risks to key partners (e.g., HAZOPs, Risk Assessments, MOCs).
  • Provide engineering expertise to support Subsurface, Projects, Finance, Vendors, and Regional collaborators.
  • Model bp values through work with a large, diverse, multi-functional team, promoting inclusion and growing capability in self and others.
  • Ensure personal and team compliance with BP’s Code of Conduct and demonstrate a commitment to safety and bp’s Who We Are framework.
  • Coach and develop others to improve leadership capability, delivery of business objectives, and a high-performance culture.

Key Competencies

  • Core: Personal & Process Safety, Procedures and Practices, OMS, Risk Assessment and Management.
  • Discipline Specific: Life of Well Design, Equipment Integrity Assurance, Well Integrity, Well Control, Well Performance, Tubular Handling & Installation, Cementing, Wellhead and Tree Installation, Directional Drilling and Surveying techniques.

Development & Training

  • Provide support and coaching to ensure safe and efficient planning/execution of activities.
  • Mentor and supervise the development of less experienced engineering staff.

Leadership & Behavioural Traits

  • Proactively lives BP values, including Code of Conduct
  • Informed Judgment: Uses good practice and sound judgment to deliver safe and reliable wells; knows when to raise issues or seek help.
  • Commitment and Engagement: Demonstrates personal commitment to delivering the plan and continuous improvement
  • Systematic Management: Applies OMS to planning and operations
  • Leadership Presence: Demonstrates courage to safely handle risk
  • Accountability: Ensures safety compliance and performance expectations are clear and delivered
  • Standout Colleague: Enables others to reach their potential
  • Safety Leader: Serves as a role model for safety
  • Good Communication Skills: Able to connect with diverse teams

Key Relationships

The Senior Drilling Engineer will be part of the P&O Wells Team Organization for the Regions Group (Brazil). The SDE will collaborate with the Discipline Lead and other Brazil engineering team members, and work with Operations, contractors, and well service personnel in office and on site. Key relationships include well planning service providers, PSCM/Logistics, Exploration/New Well Delivery, Completions Engineering, Well Test, Interventions, and Integrity teams. The Wells Operations team is based in Rio de Janeiro, with related finance, procurement, and logistics support in Rio. The current drilling engineering team is based in Houston and London.

Other key collaborators in Houston include parts of the Brazilian subsurface team and elements of the finance, logistics, and procurement teams.

Desirable Criteria & Qualifications

  • Experience constructing exploration/appraisal/development wells in Brazil
  • Significant drilling engineering experience, preferably in deepwater with an operator

We are committed to an inclusive environment where everyone is respected and treated fairly and offer benefits to help work fit with life. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Information Technology Manager role at LEDN .

Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. Through our products & services, we can make a difference in the lives and futures of our clients - in real terms. Our team at Ledn is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds. The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services!

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full-time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar role(s) in rapidly growing, security-first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code.

Role responsibilities

  • You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud first infrastructure and networks.
  • You will have a passion for innovation and creative problem solving, as well as be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment.
  • You will need to be a highly motivated, dependable and an experienced technologist who shares our passion and wants to be a part of a fast moving and highly execution-oriented team.
  • You will work closely with Cybersecurity/IT peers and stakeholder teams including Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR.
  • You will be an excellent communicator and fast learner in a supportive environment to grow IT skills.
  • This role reports to the Director of IT.

About the role

You will be customer-facing and the first line of support; you own support and you are passionate about providing an outstanding support experience to our employees — via Slack, Jira, etc. We’re all Mac. You are proficient at troubleshooting, using the terminal, and making macOS work in the enterprise. Responsibilities include procuring and delivering technology equipment, onboarding and offboarding employees, and documenting programs, policies and tools. You’ll support and manage SaaS applications (Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro/Protect/Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.) and manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools (MDM/EMM, Jamf, etc.). You’ll contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.), detail solutions, craft help articles, and automate busywork. Manage incidents, prioritize help desk tickets, and work on projects over sprints with Jira.

You Bring

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc.
  • Experience with open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • Ability to integrate SSO into Okta and create workflows in Okta; work with APIs and integrate systems; remote support across time zones; shipping and receiving hardware and customs.
  • Excellent communication skills across media; ability to write clearly in tickets, email, and Slack.
  • Clear, friendly, concise writing with cultural sensitivity; desire to provide a magical experience; solid security practices; knowledge of PGP; networking fundamentals; OSI model troubleshooting; self-management and multi-team prioritization.

Nice to have

  • Some familiarity with AWS; use of GAM and command-line tools; Jamf/Okta/Google Workspace certifications.

Culture & Benefits

We are looking for a leader who thrives in startup or tech environments and embodies our values. The ideal candidate will have a builder's mindset, be collaborative, and demonstrate integrity and accountability in handling confidential information. We offer a comprehensive total rewards package, remote-friendly options, and ownership through equity. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity. You may reach out for accommodation requests during the recruitment process.

Company & Process

Ledn is remote-first with teams across North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe. Due to high volume, not all applicants will be contacted. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response and public social media activity relevant to the role. No agencies or recruiters. We do not accept unsolicited resumes.

title: Product Manager, Lending
description:
Overview

Clutch is on a mission to transform Credit Unions into fintechs — helping them deliver digital experiences that rival the best banks and lenders in the world.

As a Product Manager on the Lending Application Intake team, you’ll support the core member application experience that powers our lending platform. You’ll work closely to deliver small features that improve the speed, accuracy, and usability of loan applications — from initial intake through decisioning.

This is a hands-on learning role where you’ll develop the fundamentals of product management within a fast-paced fintech environment. You’ll learn how digital lending works, how credit unions serve their members, and how to turn complex workflows into simple, delightful product experiences, driving impact to our credit union customers and their members.

About the Team

You’ll join a high-talent density Product & Engineering org with a culture of ownership, speed, and judgment. PMs here work shoulder-to-shoulder with engineers and GTM peers, driving clarity and tough tradeoffs instead of waiting for direction.

This is a pivotal time at Clutch: we are on a strong growth path, and how we scale account opening in the next 12 months will define how Clutch builds durable company leverage.

What You’ll Do

Within 3 months, you will:

  • Learn the fundamentals of Clutch’s Digital Lending experience, workflows, and customer personas.
  • Partner with a Senior PM and triad partners (Design + Engineering) to deliver small features and improvements end-to-end.
  • Collaborate with engineering to validate features and ensure quality delivery.
  • Shadow customer calls and internal standups to understand how fintech products serve real-world credit union needs.

Within 6 months, you will:

  • Contribute to backlog refinement, writing crisp product specs, and maintaining feature documentation.
  • Own a well-defined part of our product and lead quarterly planning for it with guidance from your manager.
  • Analyze user feedback and product data to inform backlog prioritization.
  • Present updates in demos and share learnings with your peers.

Within 9 months, you will:

  • Independently manage a small product area or recurring improvement track
  • Develop the ability to independently identify, scope, and propose enhancements that drive measurable customer impact.
  • Turning urgent needs into repeatable, scalable systems
  • Demonstrate growth in product judgment, cross-functional collaboration, and ownership mindset.

What You’ll Bring

  • Execution excellence : Proven ability to thrive in fast-paced environments; you bring urgency, energy, and follow-through. A strong signal is 2+ years of PM experience in B2B or fintech environments.
  • Collaboration skills : You partner across product, engineering, and GTM — holding the line on judgment while ensuring customers feel heard.
  • Growth mindset: A growth mindset and willingness to receive and act on feedback to improve quickly.

What’s In It For You?

  • Remote Flexibility : Enjoy the freedom of remote work from anywhere, balancing life and career seamlessly.
  • Unforgettable Off-Sites : Twice a year, bond with colleagues in exciting destinations, fostering teamwork and fresh ideas.
  • Paid Time Off and National Holidays : Enjoy 20 PTO days yearly and the National Holidays for relaxation and rejuvenation.
  • Stock Options : Joining us means having a stake in our success, so you'll receive stock options as part of your compensation package.
  • Home Office Setup : Create your ideal workspace with a dedicated budget for home office essentials.
  • Work Trip Budget : Grow personally and professionally with a budget for work-related trips and co-working.

About Us

Clutch is a revolutionary vertical SaaS company, proudly backed by Andreessen Horowitz (A16z), aimed at revolutionizing the way Credit Unions engage and change the lives of their members. As a champion of financial well-being, we address the urgent need for affordable lending solutions in an era where the average American grapples with over $155,000 in household debt. Unlike traditional financial institutions, Clutch develops software to turn Credit Unions into FinTech lenders and leverage their balance sheets to responsibly lend to over 130M Americans. Our mission extends beyond mere financial transactions; we strive to fundamentally enhance the way credit unions interact with their members. By integrating cutting-edge technologies and user-centric designs, we help credit unions provide seamless digital experiences that are on par with leading tech companies. This approach not only preserves but revitalizes the longstanding tradition of community and member-focused service inherent to credit unions.

Please note : This position is offered on a contractor basis. Applicants must have the necessary documentation and authorization to work in the country where the job is located. Clutch cannot provide sponsorship or assist with obtaining work permits for this role.

A Note About AI at Clutch : We love AI. We use it often and encourage our team to creatively and effectively leverage AI tools in their work. If you join Clutch, we hope you'll bring the same enthusiasm for exploring how AI can amplify impact, productivity, and innovation. That said, during the interview process, we want to hear your thoughts. Please approach interviews without the use of AI tools—our goal is to get to know how you think, solve problems, and communicate. Once you're in the seat, bring on the prompts!

You take security seriously, and you know what PGP is. You understand networking fundamentals and basic troubleshooting — TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching. You must be able to competently and demonstrably know the troubleshooting steps and layers of the OSI model — you know how to methodically troubleshoot problems without wasting someone''s time. You can self-manage, and can accurately scope your project, priorities, and work across multiple teams.

  • Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.

Culture Fit

We''re looking for more than just operational excellence — we want a leader who thrives in the startup or tech environment and embodies our values. The ideal candidate will have a builder''s mindset, be a collaborative partner, influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity, demonstrate integrity and accountability, and have remote work experience.

Our team is global, remote-first, and spans North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe. Please note, due to high volume of applications, only qualified applicants will be contacted. Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future.

We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world.

Through our products & services, we can make a difference in the lives and futures of our clients - in real terms. Our team at Ledn is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds.

What we all have in common is an unshakeable conviction that digital assets can democratize access to the global economy and Ledn's suite of products & services can play a critical role in doing so.

The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy.

Combining these values with our conviction make Ledn an unstoppable force in changing the world for the better.

Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services!

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT.

The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools.

A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar role(s) in rapidly growing, security-first, environments.

The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code. But, just as passionate about helping end users who are in need of help.

You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud first infrastructure and networks.

You will have a passion for innovation and creative problem solving, as well as be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment.

You will need to be a highly motivated, dependable and an experienced technologist who shares our passion and wants to be a part of a fast moving and highly execution-oriented team. You will work closely with your Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams, including, but not limited to, Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR.

The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner who is looking for a supportive environment to continue to grow their IT skills and expertise.

This role will report to the Director of IT.

About the Role

You will be customer-facing, and the first line of support; you own support, and you are passionate about providing an outstanding support experience to our employees — via Slack, Jira, etc. We\'re all Mac.

You are a pro at troubleshooting, using the terminal, and making macOS work in the enterprise. You will be responsible for procuring and delivering technology equipment. You will own the experience of tech onboarding of all new employees as well as tech retrieval of all outgoing employees.

You\'ll design, test, build, and document programs and policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge with your experience and background. You\'ll support and manage SaaS applications — Google Workspace (GSuite), Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, etc. You will work with and manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools — MDM, EMM, Jamf, etc. You\'ll own and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.)

You'll detail your solutions, craft help articles and automate busywork. Manage, respond to, and fix critical incidents and issues as needed, through to completion. You\'ll juggle help desk tickets and can effectively prioritise them. You\'ll work on projects over sprints, and detail your work in tools like Jira (you\'re experienced with agile methods and sprints).

You'll set and work to your own objective and key results with minimal direction, and can align them to the team and the company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc.
  • Ability to utilize open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • You are able to integrate SSO into Okta, create workflows in Okta.
  • You know how to work with APIs, and integrate one system to another.
  • You've provided remote support to people in multiple countries, across time zones, and you're familiar with shipping and receiving hardware and customs.
  • unusually great communication skills across all media — you can make your ideas clear, and you can help people who might be frustrated or time poor without losing your cool. You write very well, whether it's in tickets, email or Slack.
  • You write in a clear, friendly, and concise manner, and are sensitive to different cultures. A desire to provide a magical experience for others — when they win, you win. You take security seriously, and you know what PGP is.
  • You understand networking fundamentals and basic troubleshooting — TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching. You must be able to competently and demonstrably know the troubleshooting steps and layers of the OSI model — you know how to methodically troubleshoot problems without wasting someone's time.
  • You can self-manage, and can accurately scope your project, priorities, and work across multiple teams.

Strong organisational and task-management skills are critical. You\'re comfortable dealing with ambiguity, and sometimes making the right decision without all the data.

Nice to Haves: Some familiarity with AWS; GAM and command-line interfaces; Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.

Culture Fit: We\'re looking for more than just operational excellence — we want a leader who thrives in the startup or tech environment and embodies our values.

The ideal candidate will:

  • Have a passion for progress by being adaptable and resilient, and is comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high-growth, fast-paced environment.
  • Have a builder\'s mindset, excited to create, iterate, and scale IT practices.
  • Be a collaborative partner, able to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity.
  • Demonstrate integrity and accountability, especially in managing confidential information across diverse legal and cultural contexts.
  • Have worked in a remote environment before.

A Taste of What We Provide

As one of the world\'s leading digital asset companies, we provide tremendous growth opportunities. Comprehensive, best-in-class total rewards package that starts on your first day!

  • We offer a competitive PTO package that ensures you have the time off you deserve.
  • Ownership in the company. Through shared equity, Ledn employees are stakeholders in the company and the future of the digital economy.
  • We offer every employee the opportunity to work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).

A career that provides you with purpose in your job.

We remove barriers so you love what you do. We are an equal opportunity employment organization and pride ourselves on inclusivity, diversity, and the success that comes from diversity.

You may reach out to the Ledn team by emailing ****** for accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process. Requests will be addressed confidentially.

title: Senior Technical Recruiter - Frontier AI (LATAM)
description:
Overview

Join one of the world’s most ambitious AI technology companies, shaping the future of Sports, Media, and Entertainment. Proximity Works helps global brands discover high-impact AI use cases, build transformative tech stacks, and scale to hundreds of millions of users. Since 2019, Proximity Works has created and scaled AI-driven products used by 697 million daily users, generating $73.5 billion in enterprise value for our partners. We are a global team headquartered in San Francisco with offices in Los Angeles, Dubai, Mumbai, and Bangalore. We partner with some of the biggest names in sports, media, and entertainment, solving complex problems with cutting-edge AI.

Role Summary

We are seeking a hands-on Senior Technical Recruiter who will individually own the end-to-end closure of frontier AI, ML, and backend roles. This is not a traditional TA manager role. It is a high-impact recruiting position requiring technical fluency, first principles sourcing, and persuasive outreach. You will identify, engage, and close exceptional global talent who will help Proximity build world-class AI products and engineering platforms.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the end-to-end closure of senior AI, ML, multimodal, backend, and engineering hires globally.
  • Build adjacency maps of companies, labs, and communities working on relevant frontier problems.
  • Generate technical screening prompts, knockout questions, and rubrics independently.
  • Source beyond LinkedIn. Leverage GitHub, arXiv, OSS repos, Kaggle, Twitter, Discord, Substack, niche forums, and micro-communities.
  • Craft and execute compelling outreach campaigns using artifact-first hooks and Proximity’s track record as trusted partners to global sports, media, and entertainment leaders.
  • Drive urgency by compressing interview loops, managing notice-period negotiations and buyouts, and delivering offers quickly.
  • Ensure evidence-backed sourcing with GitHub repos, demos, papers, and talks, while maintaining a world-class candidate experience.

What You’ll Need

Requirements

  • Proven track record as an individual contributor recruiter, not just a TA manager.
  • Demonstrated success sourcing and closing frontier AI, ML, backend, or engineering talent globally.
  • Strong technical comprehension. Comfortable with transformer fine-tuning, multimodal pipelines involving video, audio, and text, MLOps stacks, scalable backend systems, and related domains.
  • Evidence of artifact-based sourcing such as GitHub repos, OSS contributions, research papers, or competition wins.
  • Experience in persuasive multi-touch outreach campaigns and passive talent conversion.
  • Global exposure and ability to recruit across India, EU, LATAM, or other regions with cost-sensitive hiring strategies.

Nice to Have

  • Experience hiring for early-stage or hypergrowth AI and ML product teams.
  • Success recruiting engineers in video generation, lip-sync, diffusion, audio processing, or real-time streaming.
  • Familiarity with ad-tech hiring at scale (RTB, personalization, streaming infrastructure).
  • Portfolio of outreach copy or campaigns with proven conversion results.

What Success Looks Like

  • 6 to 8 successful frontier hires per quarter across India, EU, and LATAM markets.
  • At least 80 percent of sourced candidates are evidence-backed through OSS, papers, or demos.
  • At least two positive replies per 10 passive outreach attempts.
  • SLA adherence: under 8 hours for feedback loops, under 10 days time-to-offer on urgent roles.
  • Candidate satisfaction NPS of 8 or higher.

Success Traits

Builder’s mindset · High agency · Strategic + hands-on balance · Cultural intelligence · Analytical clarity · Trustworthiness · Growth orientation

Benefits

Compensation, Benefits & Why Join Proximity

  • Competitive compensation aligned with global markets, with remote-first flexibility
  • Best-in-class health coverage
  • Annual global off-sites with Proxonauts from SF, Dubai, India
  • Help build AI/ML products and engineering teams that power global leaders in sports, streaming, and media.
  • Work directly with global CTO offices on frontier AI problem statements that shape the future of entertainment and technology.
  • High autonomy, direct accountability, and global reach.

Managers of Information Technology, Ledn is interested in hearing from you! Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. Through our products & services, we can make a difference in the lives and futures of our clients - in real terms. Our team at Ledn is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds. What we all have in common is an unshakeable conviction that digital assets can democratize access to the global economy and Ledn's suite of products & services can play a critical role in doing so. The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. Combining these values with our conviction make Ledn an unstoppable force in changing the world for the better. Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services!

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar role(s) in rapidly growing, security-first, environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code. But, just as passionate about helping end users who are in need of help. You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud first infrastructure and networks. You will have a passion for innovation and creative problem solving, as well as be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment. You will need to be a highly motivated, dependable and an experienced technologist who shares our passion and wants to be a part of a fast moving and highly execution-oriented team. You will work closely with your Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams, including, but not limited to, Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR. The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner who is looking for a supportive environment to continue to grow their IT skills and expertise. This role will report to the Director of IT.

Role and Responsibilities

  • Be customer-facing, the first line of support; own support, and provide an outstanding support experience to employees via Slack, Jira, etc. We\'re all Mac.
  • Troubleshoot, use the terminal, and make macOS work in the enterprise.
  • Procure and deliver technology equipment; own the onboarding experience for all new employees and the retrieval process for departing employees.
  • Design, test, build, and document programs, policies and tools; contribute improvements to existing knowledge.
  • Support and manage SaaS applications (Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro/Protect/Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.).
  • Manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools (MDM/EMM, Jamf, etc.).
  • Own and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.).
  • Detail solutions, craft help articles, and automate busywork.
  • Manage, respond to, and fix critical incidents and issues as needed, through to completion.
  • Balance help desk tickets with project work; work in sprints and document progress in Jira (adhere to agile methods).
  • Set and pursue objectives and key results aligned with team and company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc.
  • Experience with open source tools (Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.).
  • Ability to integrate SSO into Okta and create workflows in Okta; working knowledge of APIs and system integrations.
  • Experience providing remote support across multiple countries/time zones; familiarity with hardware shipping/receiving and customs.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication; ability to explain complex concepts clearly and empathetically.
  • Strong documentation skills and the ability to craft clear tickets, emails, and Slack messages.
  • Proven ability to self-manage, scope projects, and coordinate across multiple teams.
  • Strong organizational and task-management skills; comfortable dealing with ambiguity and making decisions with incomplete data.

Nice to Have

  • Some familiarity with AWS (no certifications required).
  • Experience with GAM and CLI work to increase efficiency.
  • Jamf, Okta, Google Workspace certifications.
  • Culture fit: leadership aligned with startup/tech environment values.

Our culture and expectations

  • Have a passion for progress; adaptable, resilient, and comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high-growth, fast-paced environment.
  • Builder’s mindset; eager to create, iterate, and scale IT practices.
  • Collaborative partner across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity.
  • Demonstrate integrity and accountability, especially with confidential information.
  • Experience working in a remote environment.

What We Provide

  • Comprehensive, best-in-class total rewards package starting on day one.
  • Competitive PTO package and ownership in the company; equity through shared ownership.
  • Opportunity to work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (restrictions apply).
  • A career with purpose; we remove barriers so you love what you do.
  • We are an equal opportunity employer; inclusive and diverse, with success from diversity.

Application and Environment

  • You may reach out to the Ledn team by emailing for accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process. Requests will be addressed confidentially.
  • Ledn is a globally distributed, remote-first team spanning North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe.

Boa sorte!

A Wilson Sons Ultratug Offshore é uma joint venture entre a Wilson Sons e a Ultramar. A Wilson Sons é um dos maiores operadores integrados de serviços marítimos, portuários e de logística do Brasil, com mais 180 anos de experiência. A Ultramar é um grupo chileno com mais de 60 anos de experiência, presença em 15 países e grande experiência em serviços de agenciamento marítimo, apoio portuário, logística e transporte.

Com 23 embarcações, a Wilson Sons Offshore oferece apoio marítimo a plataformas de exploração e produção de petróleo e gás. No trajeto entre as plataformas e os terminais portuários, as embarcações PSV transportam equipamentos, lama de perfuração, tubos, cimento e alimentos, entre outros materiais necessários ao negócio dos clientes da indústria de petróleo e gás, e trazem ao continente os dejetos acumulados nas plataformas. Além disso, a empresa também opera com embarcações LSV.

Trata-se do segmento mais jovem da Wilson Sons: suas atividades foram iniciadas em 2003. Hoje já contamos com uma das maiores e mais modernas frotas em apoio Offshore com bandeira brasileira.

O compromisso da Wilson Sons Ultratug Offshore é continuar investindo para apoiar o crescimento de seus clientes e do Brasil. A meta deste ano frente a este cenário desafiador é a redução dos custos e o aumento de produtividade.

description:
Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Realizar atendimento clínico e cirúrgico em Ortopedia nas áreas: CER, enfermarias, centro cirúrgico, unidade de terapia intensiva e ambulatório do Hospital.

A SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina

A SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas,Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Assim, a SPDM contribui de forma efetiva para a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados pelo Sistema Único de Saúde do Brasil, visando principalmente garantir a universalidade e as oportunidades de acesso à saúde, necessárias ao desenvolvimento humano e social do cidadão. Para tanto, associa o melhor da tecnologia com atendimento médico de alta qualidade, respaldado por equipes multiprofissionais, formadas por enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêuticos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos, bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas, entre outros.

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades no ano de 2001 no município de São Paulo, se estendendo para outros municípios e estados. Desde o início de suas atividades, oPAIS busca, em parceria com a gestão pública, o crescimento e a consolidação dos serviços de saúde ofertados aos usuários do SUS.

O Programa tem como objetivo garantir mudanças nos indicadores e na qualidade de vida da população, pautado, entre outros, pelos princípios da integralidade e da equidade, com uma visão estratégica da gestão dos serviços de saúde, definida em um processo de aprimoramento contínuo.

Inclusão

A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira, para pessoas com deficiência. Para tanto, periodicamente publica anúncio recrutando esses profissionais, nos principais jornais de São Paulo e dos municípios em que se localizam suas unidades.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas com a gestão pública, em benefício da população de forma ética e humanizada, qualidade técnica, com compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, abrangendo todos os níveis da assistência, garantindo atendimento com qualidade à população dos municípios e estados parceiros.
