Overview

JOB DESCRIPTION

Medical Writer / Senior Scientific Communications Specialist (French)

Position Summary

The Senior Scientific Communications Specialist is a professional with scientific, clinical, and therapeutic area expertise, responsible for oversight of staff and client services. The position also provides scientifically accurate and balanced information to internal stakeholders, external healthcare professionals, and consumers in a way that supports business needs; is aligned with regulatory and compliance practices; and is consistent with Medical Affairs and brand team objectives.

Essential Functions

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Essential Functions

  • Develop and review content for scientific documents including standard and custom responses, slide decks, dossiers, manuscripts, slide decks, and other deliverables requested by the client.
  • Demonstrate ongoing scientific expertise relevant to therapeutic areas, including products, disease state management, and emerging therapies.
  • Integrate scientific expertise with knowledge of regulatory and compliance guidelines to ensure comprehensive review of materials submitted into the approval process.
  • Create and/or review medical affairs materials and promotional materials.
  • Apply approved standards of style to created and maintained materials.
  • Demonstrate proficiency in the use of content management systems as applicable.
  • Update Standard Response format and content for integration into a global content management system.
  • Respond to Medical Information Requests (via calls/web/emails/letters) and conduct appropriate scientific information exchanges with the requestors.
  • Participate in scientific training as appropriate to support assigned brands.
  • Comply with all guidelines, policies, legal, regulatory, and compliance requirements.
  • Meet or exceed service levels and targets for internal and external customers.
  • Participate in training and mentoring of new hires or staff changing support areas.

The Senior Scientific Communications Specialist may also be responsible for the following:

  • Serve as a team lead for 1 or more Clients, therapeutic areas, workstreams, or brands.
  • Coordinate with Client to schedule meetings and training sessions, and ensure that all team members meet all training requirements.
  • Manage and distribute overall workload for a brand or therapeutic area.
  • Coordinate, lead, and participate in workstreams, special projects, pilots, or other activities requested by the client.
  • Serve as key contact for communications between the Client and Med Communications team.
  • Maintain active role in Quality Assurance processes, including monitoring of performance indicators.
  • Provide medical information support via multiple venues including virtual presentations and medical meeting booth coverage.

Qualifications

  • Above average attention to detail, teamwork and initiative.
  • Ability to interact with other departments within the company and be proficient in written and verbal communication.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint and Word, and quickly able to learn new software.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in drug information communication and management.
  • Ability to apply regulatory and compliance guidelines to content development.

Competencies

  • Attendance - Always on time for work, including meetings and conferences. Strong attendance record and punctuality with deliverables.
  • Innovation and Creativity - Thinks in new ways to develop ideas and improve processes.
  • Leadership - Leads, motivates, and communicates effectively; delegates appropriately.
  • Communication Skills - Clear, concise, and responsive; provides constructive feedback.
  • Collaboration and Teamwork - Works with others to achieve goals; problem solves and shares responsibility.
  • Customer Service - Professional, patient, proactive, and supportive.
  • Time Management - Prioritizes tasks and delivers results on time.
  • Work Ethic - Motivated, reliable, professional, and respectful.
  • Behavior and Attitude - Maintains positive and respectful workplace behavior.
  • Self-Motivated - Driven to perform tasks effectively.
  • Organized - Systematic in task execution.
  • Accuracy - Delivers accurate and thorough work.
  • Technical Aptitude - Understands complex technical topics.
  • Applied Learning - Engages in learning activities to maximize outcomes.

Education, Languages, Experience

  • Education: Advanced degree in pharmacy (PharmD preferred), advanced health care degree, or relevant, equivalent clinical experience.
  • Languages: English and French – C1 or C2, Fluent or Professional Level.
  • Experience: Two to four years of related experience in scientific content creation within the pharmaceutical industry, medical education, and/or academia. Demonstrated expertise in drug information communication and management preferred. Drug Information or Clinical Residency preferred.
  • Computer Skills: Proficiency with Embase, Ovid, and content management systems preferred.
  • Other Requirements: Preference for pharmaceutical industry writing experience including understanding of FDA, legal, regulatory and compliance requirements relevant to medical affairs.

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations Cloud, a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, Equipment Monitoring, and Site Visibility. You’ll be responsible for our Public Sector referral partners and tier 2 reseller partners - building scalable programs to drive business via Tier 1 and Tier 2 partner motions, sharing Samsara’s innovation with our partners, and helping to drive a differentiated presence in the market.

A empresa investe continuamente em transformação digital, tecnologia e diversidade, criando um ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo.

Nós representamos uma macro-área de Data Analytics. Nosso time é dividido por pessoas com perfis variados de dados (Analistas de Dados, Engenheiros de Dados, Cientistas, Business Analytics, etc) e também por pessoas com perfil atuante em Pricing, Finanças, Produto e Planejamento Estratégico. Nossa função é navegar por todas as BU's da vertical (grand chef, plus delivery, aiqfome) e conseguir entregar recomendações de negócios baseadas no que os dados estão nos dizendo, para isso, você estará diariamente em contato com times de Marketing, Vendas, Produto, e Tecnologia.

  • Somos uma área que tem por objetivo evangelizar a cultura de dados e experimentação;
  • Faremos estudos de eficiência, apontaremos caminhos e compartilharemos aprendizados;
  • Somos um time aficcionado pelo nosso usuário: seja ele o fominha, seller, CM, indústria ou fomer;
  • Criaremos uma plataforma de dados robusta, com automatização, dashboards e modelos de AI;
  • Se você precisa fazer a mesma coisa todo dia/semana, você precisa automatiza-la.

Descrição do Cargo

Como será o seu dia a dia

  • Liderança na Estratégia e Coleta de Dados: Liderar a identificação, avaliação e extração de dados de fontes complexas e variadas (bancos de dados, APIs, data lakes), definindo as melhores práticas e garantindo a integridade e relevância dos dados para as análises estratégicas.
  • Modelagem e Governança de Dados: Desenvolver e implementar processos robustos de limpeza, transformação e modelagem de dados, garantindo a qualidade, consistência e governança das informações em toda a empresa.
  • Análise Preditiva e Diagnóstica: Conduzir análises complexas, incluindo modelagem estatística, testes de hipóteses e análises preditivas, para diagnosticar tendências, identificar oportunidades de crescimento e prever cenários futuros.
  • Desenvolvimento e Liderança de Dashboards Estratégicos: Projetar, desenvolver e gerenciar dashboards e relatórios estratégicos para a alta gestão, focando em KPIs que direcionem o desempenho do negócio e facilitem a tomada de decisão em tempo real.
  • Parceria Estratégica com Áreas de Negócio: Atuar como um parceiro estratégico para as lideranças, compreendendo profundamente suas necessidades e traduzindo desafios de negócio em projetos de dados que gerem valor e impacto mensurável.
  • Otimização e Arquitetura de Consultas: Elaborar e otimizar consultas SQL complexas em grandes volumes de dados.
  • Contribuir para a arquitetura e performance dos bancos de dados analíticos.
  • Automação e Escalabilidade de Processos: Liderar a automação de pipelines de dados e processos analíticos, utilizando ferramentas de ETL/ELT para aumentar a eficiência, escalabilidade e confiabilidade das nossas operações de dados.
  • Comunicação e Influência: Comunicar insights e recomendações de forma clara e persuasiva para audiências diversas, incluindo executivos e stakeholders não técnicos, influenciando a tomada de decisões estratégicas.
  • Mentoria e Desenvolvimento da Equipe: Atuar como mentor para analistas de dados júnior e pleno, compartilhando conhecimento, promovendo as melhores práticas e contribuindo para o desenvolvimento técnico e analítico da equipe.
  • Inovação e Pesquisa: Pesquisar e implementar novas tecnologias, metodologias e abordagens em análise de dados e machine learning, mantendo a empresa na vanguarda das práticas do mercado.
  • Precisamos Que Você Tenha
  • Formação Acadêmica: Graduação completa em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Estatística, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Pós-graduação ou mestrado em áreas relacionadas a dados será considerado um diferencial.
  • Proficiência em SQL (MySQL e Google BigQuery): Experiência avançada na criação e otimização de consultas complexas.
  • Conhecimento em Window Functions, CTEs (Common Table Expressions) e boas práticas para performance e controle de custos em ambientes de nuvem.
  • Expertise em Ferramentas de BI (Power BI e Looker Studio): Domínio completo de pelo menos uma das ferramentas (preferencialmente ambas) para criar dashboards complexos, interativos e de alto impacto.
  • Experiência com modelagem de dados (DAX no Power BI) e integração de múltiplas fontes de dados.
  • Programação em Python para Análise de Dados: Proficiência em Python e suas principais bibliotecas de dados (Pandas, NumPy).
  • Experiência na automação de processos, manipulação de grandes volumes de dados e integração com APIs.
  • Conhecimento Estatístico Aplicado: Sólida compreensão de conceitos estatísticos e sua aplicação prática em negócios (testes A/B, análise de regressão, testes de hipóteses) para validar resultados e gerar insights mais profundos.
  • Google Workspace (Planilhas e Apresentações): Habilidade para ir além do uso básico, utilizando Google Sheets para análises rápidas e prototipagem, e Google Slides para comunicar resultados complexos de forma clara e persuasiva para a liderança.
  • Resolução de Problemas: Capacidade de solucionar problemas técnicos complexos com autonomia.
  • Trabalho em Equipe: Colaborativo com times multidisciplinares.

The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. Combining these values with our conviction make Ledn an unstoppable force in changing the world for the better. Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services!

Note: The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar role(s) in rapidly growing, security-first, environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code.

Responsibilities

  • You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud first infrastructure and networks.
  • You will be customer-facing, and the first line of support; you own support, and you are passionate about providing an outstanding support experience to our employees — via Slack, Jira, etc.
  • You are a pro at troubleshooting, using the terminal, and making macOS work in the enterprise.
  • You will be responsible for procuring and delivering technology equipment.
  • You will own the experience of tech onboarding of all new employees as well as tech retrieval of all outgoing employees.
  • You\'ll design, test, build, and document programs and policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge with your experience and background.
  • You\'ll support and manage SaaS applications — Google Workspace (GSuite), Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.
  • You will work with and manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools — MDM, EMM, Jamf, etc.
  • You\'ll own and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.)
  • You\'ll detail your solutions, craft help articles and automate busywork.
  • Manage, respond to, and fix critical incidents and issues as needed, through to completion.
  • You\'ll work on projects over sprints, and detail your work in tools like Jira (you\'re experienced with agile methods and sprints).
  • You\'ll set and work to your own objective and key results with minimal direction, and can align them to the team and the company goals.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc.
  • Ability to utilize open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • You are able to integrate SSO into Okta, create workflows in Okta.
  • You know how to work with APIs, and integrate one system to another.
  • You\'ve provided remote support to people in multiple countries, across time zones, and you\'re familiar with shipping and receiving hardware and customs.
  • Unusually great communication skills across all media — you can make your ideas clear, and you can help people who might be frustrated or time poor without losing your cool.
  • You write very well, whether it\'s in tickets, email or Slack.
  • You write in a clear, friendly, and concise manner, and are sensitive to different cultures.
  • A desire to provide a magical experience for others — when they win, you win.
  • You take security seriously, and you know what PGP is.
  • You understand networking fundamentals and basic troubleshooting — TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching.
  • You must be able to competently and demonstrably know the troubleshooting steps and layers of the OSI model — you know how to methodically troubleshoot problems without wasting someone\'s time.
  • You can self-manage, and can accurately scope your project, priorities, and work across multiple teams.
  • Strong organisational and task-management skills are critical.
  • You\'re comfortable dealing with ambiguity, and sometimes making the right decision without all the data.

Nice to Haves

  • Some familiarity with AWS and related environments.
  • Experience with GAM and command-line interfaces for efficiency.
  • Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.

Culture Fit

  • We\'re looking for a leader who thrives in the startup or tech environment and embodies our values.
  • Have a passion for progress by being adaptable and resilient, and is comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high-growth, fast-paced environment.
  • Have a builder\'s mindset, excited to create, iterate, and scale IT practices.
  • Be a collaborative partner, able to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity.
  • Demonstrate integrity and accountability, especially in managing confidential information across diverse legal and cultural contexts.
  • Have worked in a remote environment before.

What We Provide

  • Comprehensive, best-in-class total rewards package that starts on your first day.
  • Competitive PTO package and ownership in the company. Through shared equity, Ledn employees are stakeholders in the company.
  • The option to work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).
  • A career that provides you with purpose in your job.
  • We are an equal opportunity employment organization and pride ourselves on inclusivity, diversity, and the success that comes from diversity.

You may reach out to the Ledn team by emailing for accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process. Requests will be addressed confidentially.

Ledn Working Environment: Our team is globally distributed and remote-first. Due to high volume of applications, only those who qualify will be contacted. description:
Overview

This position is posted by Jobgether on behalf of a partner company. We are currently looking for a Technical Product Support Engineer (Remote) in Latin America .

As a Technical Product Support Engineer, you will play a key role in delivering high-quality technical support for innovative connectivity and communication products. You will troubleshoot complex VoIP, SIP, and API issues, ensuring smooth operations and customer satisfaction. The role involves direct interaction with clients via chat, email, and calls, while collaborating closely with engineering and operations teams to resolve technical challenges.   • Strong knowledge of SIP, RTP, T.38, and other Voice over IP and Fax over IP protocols
  • Experience in product support or technical support roles, preferably with VoIP or telephony technologies
  • Proficiency with Linux, terminal commands, and network troubleshooting tools such as Wireshark and Tshark
  • Familiarity with API technologies and tools like Postman for troubleshooting
  • Excellent communication, listening, and interpersonal skills to interact confidently with clients
  • Ability to multi-task, prioritize workload, and work independently in a remote environment
  • Problem-solving mindset with a proactive approach to assisting customers and resolving issues

Benefits

  • Remote work across Latin America with flexible schedule
  • Opportunity to work with innovative communication and connectivity technologies
  • Exposure to advanced troubleshooting tools and industry protocols
  • Collaboration with a skilled, distributed team of engineers and technical experts
  • Professional growth and skill development in technical support and product engineering

title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Overview

Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. Through our products & services, we can make a difference in the lives and futures of our clients - in real terms. Our team at Ledn is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds. What we all have in common is an unshakeable conviction that digital assets can democratize access to the global economy and Ledn's suite of products & services can play a critical role in doing so. The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. Combining these values with our conviction make Ledn an unstoppable force in changing the world for the better. Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services!

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar role(s) in rapidly growing, security-first, environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code. But, just as passionate about helping end users who are in need of help. You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud first infrastructure and networks. You will have a passion for innovation and creative problem solving, as well as be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment. You will need to be a highly motivated, dependable and an experienced technologist who shares our passion and wants to be a part of a fast moving and highly execution-oriented team. You will work closely with your Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams, including, but not limited to, Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR. The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner who is looking for a supportive environment to continue to grow their IT skills and expertise. This role will report to the Director of IT.

Role & Responsibilities

You will be customer-facing, and the first line of support; you own support, and you are passionate about providing an outstanding support experience to our employees — via Slack, Jira, etc. We're all Mac.

You are a pro at troubleshooting, using the terminal, and making macOS work in the enterprise. You will be responsible for procuring and delivering technology equipment. You will own the experience of tech onboarding of all new employees as well as tech retrieval of all outgoing employees. You'll design, test, build, and document programs and policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge with your experience and background. You'll support and manage SaaS applications — Google Workspace (GSuite), Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, etc. You will work with and manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools — MDM, EMM, Jamf, etc. You'll own and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.) You'll detail your solutions, craft help articles and automate busywork. Manage, respond to, and fix critical incidents and issues as needed, through to completion. You're comfortable juggling help desk tickets and can effectively prioritise them. You'll work on projects over sprints, and detail your work in tools like Jira (you're experienced with agile methods and sprints).

You'll set and work to your own objective and key results with minimal direction, and can align them to the team and the company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn

7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite. Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc. Ability to utilize open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc. You are able to integrate SSO into Okta, create workflows in Okta. You know how to work with APIs, and integrate one system to another. You've provided remote support to people in multiple countries, across time zones, and you're familiar with shipping and receiving hardware and customs. Unusually great communication skills across all media — you can make your ideas clear, and you can help people who might be frustrated or time poor without losing your cool. You write very well, whether it's in tickets, email or Slack.

You write in a clear, friendly, and concise manner, and are sensitive to different cultures. A desire to provide a magical experience for others — when they win, you win. You take security seriously, and you know what PGP is. You understand networking fundamentals and basic troubleshooting — TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching. You must be able to competently and demonstrably know the troubleshooting steps and layers of the OSI model — you know how to methodically troubleshoot problems without wasting someone's time. You can self-manage, and can accurately scope your project, priorities, and work across multiple teams.

Strong organisational and task-management skills are critical. You're comfortable dealing with ambiguity, and sometimes making the right decision without all the data.

Nice to Haves

Some familiarity with AWS (you will not need certifications, but you will have used these environments a bit). You've used tools like GAM and command-line interfaces to do lots of work with less effort. Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications. Culture Fit: We're looking for more than just operational excellence — we want a leader who thrives in the startup or tech environment and embodies our values.

The ideal candidate will: Have a passion for progress by being adaptable and resilient, and is comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high-growth, fast-paced environment. Have a builder's mindset, excited to create, iterate, and scale IT practices. Be a collaborative partner, able to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity. Demonstrate integrity and accountability, especially in managing confidential information across diverse legal and cultural contexts. Have worked in a remote environment before.

A Taste of What We Provide

As one of the world's leading digital asset companies, we provide tremendous growth opportunities. Comprehensive, best-in-class total rewards package that starts on your first day! We offer a competitive PTO package that ensures you have the time off you deserve. Ownership in the company. Through shared equity, Ledn employees are stakeholders in the company and the future of the digital economy. We offer every employee the opportunity to work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions). A career that provides you with purpose in your job. We remove barriers so you love what you do. We are an equal opportunity employment organization and pride ourselves on inclusivity, diversity, and the success that comes from diversity. You may reach out to the Ledn team by emailing ****** for accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process. Requests will be addressed confidentially.

Ledn Working Environment

Our Ledn team is truly global in nature with our people spanning across North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe. We are a remote first environment. Please note, due to the high volume of applications, only those applicants that qualify will be contacted. As part of our selection process, shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response and we may review publicly available social media activity relevant to the role. No agencies or recruiters please. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and we are not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

  • Employment type: Full-time
  • Job function: Information Technology
  • Industries: Retail

title: Analista de Dados Pleno
description:
Overview

Junte-se à nossa energia! Somos a Eletrobras, empresa líder em geração e transmissão de energia elétrica no Brasil e na América Latina. Alinhados à nossa Cultura e Propósito, trabalhamos de forma integrada para contribuir com o desenvolvimento sustentável que gere valor para toda a sociedade.

Se você quer fazer parte da nossa companhia e se tornar um de nossos talentos, saiba que estamos com uma oportunidade em aberto, em modelo presencial. Com o seu talento podemos ir ainda mais longe, guiados pelo nosso propósito de cuidar do planeta entregando a energia em que a gente acredita.

Atenção: A Eletrobras não cobra taxas para realização de testes, exames ou participação no processo seletivo.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Descrição do Cargo:

Liderar o desenvolvimento e a implementação de modelos de análise de dados avançados e inteligência artificial no Centro de Monitoramento LIGA. O objetivo é aprimorar a detecção proativa de anomalias, otimizar a manutenção preditiva e apoiar estrategicamente a gestão da confiabilidade e desempenho dos ativos de geração e transmissão da Eletrobras, utilizando insights baseados em dados para minimizar o downtime e estender o ciclo de vida dos ativos.

Principais Atividades

  • Analisar grandes volumes de dados operacionais (tempo real e históricos) dos ativos monitorados;
  • Desenvolver modelos preditivos para falhas, degradações de desempenho e eventos críticos;
  • Criar algoritmos e scripts para automatizar detecção de anomalias e alertas inteligentes;
  • Construir dashboards interativos e relatórios analíticos para apoiar a gestão de ativos;
  • Colaborar com engenheiros e analistas para interpretar os dados à luz da engenharia de manutenção.

Requisitos e qualificações

Requisitos Obrigatórios:

  • Formação Superior completo em Ciência de Dados, Engenharia, Estatística, Análise de Sistemas ou áreas correlatas;
  • Domínio em técnicas de Machine Learning, Modelagem Estatística e Inteligência Artificial aplicadas à detecção de anomalias e previsão de falhas;
  • Proficiência em linguagens como Python ou R, com experiência em bibliotecas como Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow ou PyTorch;
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL, processamento de dados em tempo real e ferramentas de Big Data;
  • Excelência na criação de dashboards interativos (Power BI) e visualizações voltadas à tomada de decisão;
  • Familiaridade com arquiteturas de dados, pipelines de ETL e ambientes em nuvem (cloud);
  • Experiência em projetos de análise de dados, preferencialmente aplicados à indústria, energia ou manutenção.

Requisitos Desejáveis:

  • Pós-graduação ou certificações em Machine Learning, Data Analytics, Engenharia de Confiabilidade ou Inteligência Artificial Aplicada à Indústria;
  • Conhecimento em Engenharia da Confiabilidade (FMEA, RCM, RAM), ISO 55.000, SAP PM, SCADA e SAGE;
  • Experiência com dados operacionais, modelagem preditiva e integração de sistemas é um diferencial relevante.

Informações adicionais

Na Eletrobras, o bem-estar e a qualidade de vida dos nossos profissionais também fazem parte da Nossa Energia. Oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho que valoriza o equilíbrio entre vida pessoal e profissional, com benefícios que promovem o bem-estar, o desenvolvimento e as necessidades das equipes. Benefícios escolhidos normalmente incluem:

  • Alimentação: Vale-refeição e vale-alimentação;
  • Plano Médico e Odontológico;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Previdência Privada;
  • Participação nos lucros;
  • Vale-Transporte;
  • Gympass;
  • Auxílio-creche;
  • Auxílio educacional;
  • Universidade corporativa interna que contribui com a aprendizagem diária dos profissionais

Se esses benefícios e essa posição fazem sentido para você, inscreva-se já!

title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Overview

Managers of Information Technology, Ledn is interested in hearing from you! Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. Through our products & services, we can make a difference in the lives and futures of our clients. Our team at Ledn is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds. The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services!

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar role(s) in rapidly growing, security-first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code. You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud-first infrastructure and networks. You will have a passion for innovation and creative problem solving, as well as be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment. You will need to be a highly motivated, dependable and an experienced technologist who shares our passion and wants to be a part of a fast moving and highly execution-oriented team. You will work closely with your Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams, including, but not limited to, Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR. The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner who is looking for a supportive environment to continue to grow their IT skills and expertise. This role will report to the Director of IT.

Role Details

You will be customer-facing, and the first line of support; you own support, and you are passionate about providing an outstanding support experience to our employees — via Slack, Jira, etc. We’re all Mac. You are a pro at troubleshooting, using the terminal, and making macOS work in the enterprise. You will be responsible for procuring and delivering technology equipment. You will own the experience of tech onboarding of all new employees as well as tech retrieval of all outgoing employees. You’ll design, test, build, and document programs and policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge with your experience and background. You’ll support and manage SaaS applications — Google Workspace (GSuite), Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, etc. You will work with and manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools — MDM, EMM, Jamf, etc. You'll own and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.). You'll detail your solutions, craft help articles and automate busywork. Manage, respond to, and fix critical incidents and issues as needed, through to completion. You'll set and work to your own objectives and key results with minimal direction, and can align them to the team and the company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc.
  • Ability to utilize open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • You are able to integrate SSO into Okta, create workflows in Okta.
  • You know how to work with APIs, and integrate one system to another.
  • You've provided remote support to people in multiple countries, across time zones, and you're familiar with shipping and receiving hardware and customs.
  • Unusually great communication skills across all media — you can make your ideas clear, and you can help people who might be frustrated or time poor without losing your cool. You write very well, whether it's in tickets, email or Slack.
  • You write in a clear, friendly, and concise manner, and are sensitive to different cultures. A desire to provide a magical experience for others — when they win, you win. You take security seriously, and you know what PGP is.
  • You understand networking fundamentals and basic troubleshooting — TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching. You must be able to competently and demonstrably know the troubleshooting steps and layers of the OSI model — you know how to methodically troubleshoot problems without wasting someone's time.
  • You can self-manage, and can accurately scope your project, priorities, and work across multiple teams. Strong organisational and task-management skills are critical.
  • You're comfortable dealing with ambiguity, and sometimes making the right decision without all the data.

Nice to Haves

  • Some familiarity with AWS (not required to have certifications).
  • Experience with GAM and command-line interfaces to work efficiently.
  • Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.
  • Culture Fit: a leader who thrives in startup/tech environments and embodies our values.

The Ideal Candidate

  • Has a passion for progress, adaptability, resilience, and comfort navigating ambiguity in a high-growth, fast-paced environment.
  • Has a builder's mindset, is excited to create, iterate, and scale IT practices.
  • Is a collaborative partner, able to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity.
  • Demonstrates integrity and accountability, especially in managing confidential information across diverse legal and cultural contexts.
  • Has worked in a remote environment before.

What We Provide

  • Comprehensive, best-in-class total rewards package starting from day one.
  • Competitive PTO and ownership in the company; through shared equity, Ledn employees are stakeholders in the future.
  • Opportunity to work remotely from anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).
  • A career with purpose and a culture that removes barriers so you can love what you do.
  • Ledn is an equal opportunity employer committed to inclusivity and diversity.

Additional Information

You may reach out to the Ledn team by emailing for accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process. Requests will be addressed confidentially. Our team is global and remote-first. Due to high volume of applications, only qualified applicants will be contacted. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response; we may review publicly available social media activity relevant to the role. No agencies or recruiters please. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and are not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Na Qive, estamos comprometidos em mudar a forma como o mercado se relaciona com Documentos Fiscais Eletrônicos (DFes), reduzindo horas operacionais, conomizando custos e mitigando riscos. Nossa cultura é orientada pela inovação, responsabilidade e agilidade, sempre com o objetivo de liderar o mercado e oferecer soluções que impulsionem o crescimento de nossos clientes.

Requisitos

  • Conhecimento em ISO 27001, LGPD, gestão de riscos, auditorias e SoA;
  • Vivência com gestão de equipes técnicas, incluindo contratação, feedbacks, desenvolvimento e desligamentos;
  • Proficiência técnica em arquitetura de segurança de sistemas web e cloud (identidade, IAM, criptografia, monitoramento, incident response);
  • Experiência em traduzir requisitos regulatórios e de negócio em soluções técnicas viáveis;
  • Familiaridade com gestão de fornecedores de segurança e acompanhamento de contratos/SLAs.

Será um diferencial se você tiver

  • Certificações de mercado: CISSP, CISM, CISA, ISO 27001 LA/LI;
  • Experiência prática com DevSecOps e integração de segurança em pipelines de desenvolvimento;
  • Atuação prévia em empresas SaaS da área fiscal/financeira;
  • Experiência em FinOps aplicado à segurança, com otimização de custos de ferramentas e licenças;

Benefícios

  • Plano de saúde Unimed com cobertura nacional, sem desconto de mensalidade ou coparticipação para nossos Qivers e seus filhos;
  • Plano odontológico com cobertura nacional, sem descontos em folha e possibilidade de inclusão de filhos, parentes, pais e sogros;
  • Benefício Flash Flex com um valor bem competitivo, aceito em restaurantes, supermercados, padarias, mobilidade, bem-estar, saúde, educação, cultura e entretenimento, sem nenhum desconto;
  • Programa de Participação nos Resultados da empresa (PPR) competitivo com o mercado;
  • Licença maternidade e paternidade estendidas, inclusive para adoção e casais homoafetivos;
  • Ajuda de custo ao qiver nos 03 primeiros meses após o nascimento ou adoção no valor de R$ 1.000,00 adiantados;
  • Auxílio creche ou babá para filhos de até 06 anos de idade;
  • Total Pass;
  • Cartão Alelo Multibenefícios;
  • Seguro de vida.

E mais

  • Trabalho remoto, liberdade geográfica em qualquer lugar do país;
  • Enviamos todos os equipamentos necessários para montar o seu escritório em casa, mas se você preferir temos uma sede com estacionamento gratuito, lanches e bebidas liberadas e um ambiente super descontraído.
  • Ambiente de aprendizado e desenvolvimento constante, incentivando o crescimento individual, feedbacks e trabalho em equipe;
  • Valorizamos o bem-estar, por isso temos aulas online e gratuitas de Yoga, Meditação e Ginástica Laboral;
  • Pensando na saúde mental e no desenvolvimento, também temos parceiros como Ana Health, Vamos Escrever e Cambly.

Diversidade é aprendizado e inclusão é necessária na Qive

Estamos em constante aprendizado para garantir que todas as pessoas possuam liberdade e respeito para falar e ouvir e sentir em seu dia a dia as experiências positivas apresentadas pela Qive! Isso é mais do que resolver uma dor em comum, queremos ser melhores sempre, queremos mudar o jogo seja ele qual for. E contamos com você para fazer a diferença e isso independe de sua crença, gênero, orientação sexual, cor de pele, deficiência ou classe social.

Em nossos processos seletivos coletamos e tratamos os dados pessoais fornecidos no formulário de candidatura da vaga (o que inclui tanto os dados informados em cada campo do formulário, quanto os que estiverem presentes no currículo anexado) e dados que podem ser solicitados nas próximas etapas. Informamos ainda que realizamos toda a gestão das vagas por meio do sistema InHire, não possuindo vínculo com outras plataformas em que as nossas vagas são espelhadas. Overview

Join to apply for the Information Technology Manager role at LEDN .

The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. Ledn aims to be an unstoppable force in changing the world for the better. Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full-time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many hats, including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar roles in rapidly growing, security-first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and infrastructure as code, and is excited to help end users who need assistance.

You will participate in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud-first infrastructure and networks. You will be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment and work closely with Cybersecurity/IT peers and stakeholder teams (Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR). The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner seeking a supportive environment to grow IT skills and expertise. This role reports to the Director of IT.

About the Role

You will be customer-facing and the first line of support; you own support and are passionate about providing an outstanding experience to employees via Slack, Jira, etc. We are primarily Mac environments. You will procure and deliver technology equipment and manage tech onboarding for new employees and tech retrieval for departing employees.

You will design, test, build, and document programs, policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge. You will support and manage SaaS applications such as Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro/Protect/Connect, Okta, Jira, etc. You will manage Mac endpoints and mobile device management tools (MDM/EMM) and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta). You will create solution documentation and automation to reduce manual work. You will manage incidents and tickets, prioritize workload, and participate in projects over sprints using Jira and agile methods. You will set objectives and key results aligned with team and company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn: 7+ years in SaaS systems administration (Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite). Automation skills (bash, zsh, python). Experience with open source tools (Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.). Ability to integrate SSO into Okta, create workflows, and work with APIs to connect systems. Remote support across multiple countries/time zones; familiarity with hardware shipping and customs. Excellent written and verbal communication across media. Ability to draft clear tickets, emails, and Slack messages. Comfort with security principles and basic networking (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing, OSI model). Self-management with the ability to scope work and coordinate across teams. Strong organizational and task-management skills; comfort with ambiguity.

Nice to Have: Some familiarity with AWS; experience with GAM and command-line interfaces; certifications (Jamf, Okta, Google Workspace). Culture fit: leadership mindset, adaptability, empathy, and a collaborative approach in a remote, fast-paced environment.

What We Provide

Comprehensive total rewards package, remote-friendly with up to 180 days remote eligibility (subject to restrictions); ownership in the company through equity; a purpose-driven career; inclusive, diverse, and equal opportunity employer. We welcome accommodation requests via email for recruitment process stages; responses are confidential.

Company and Hiring Notes

Ledn’s team is global, remote-first, with presence across North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe. Due to high volume of applications, only qualified applicants will be contacted. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response; we may review publicly available social media relevant to the role. No agencies or recruiters please. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and are not responsible for fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Overview

Join to apply for the Senior Creative Performance Strategist role at Darkroom .

About Darkroom Darkroom is a technology-driven growth marketing firm focused on growth-stage consumer companies. We were founded in 2017 out of a conviction that the iconic ad agencies of tomorrow would look very different. Darkroom is a human services firm built on a universal AI commerce layer called Matter. Our model deploys a unique blend of senior, human resources enriched by an agentic technology stack that enhances output, efficiency, and revenue generation for our clients. Our team has driven billions of dollars in trackable revenue across ecommerce, direct-to-consumer, and social commerce programs. We accelerate results for our portfolio by developing high-impact digital strategies that unlock revenue growth, transform marketing operations, and prioritize profitability. This role is fully remote within EST business hours and open to candidates in Brazil, Mexico, Portugal, and Spain.

About The Role We’re looking for a visionary creative leader with deep experience in developing ad concepts for acquisition marketing on Meta. You’ll dive into pixels, provide tactical feedback on design and video, and connect performance frameworks with creative testing and world-building assets. You’re likely a Designer or Creative Strategist by trade but focused on paid media. You’ll work on our Performance Creative service, our AI-powered creative strategy engagement for paid media clients. This role blends creativity with data-informed decision making and reports to the Director of Creative, leading Designers and Editors to execute paid media assets across a variety of formats, including static ads, short-form videos, motion graphics, and UGC content. Your work will directly impact client performance through a high volume of ad concepts, elevated creative direction, and data-backed testing frameworks. You’ll collaborate with performance marketers, designers, and video editors in a fast-paced, remote environment.

What You’ll Do

Management Responsibilities

  • Manage a team of 2-4 designers focused on paid ad creative, with room to grow the team over time.
  • Provide creative direction, actionable feedback, and career support through regular 1:1s and project reviews.
  • Oversee creative quality, ensuring assets align with brand identity, platform best practices, and campaign objectives.
  • Partner with performance marketers and strategists to develop and iterate on high-performing ad campaigns.
  • Help refine internal processes, establish creative standards, and lead collaborative sessions to drive creative innovation.

Senior Individual Contributor Responsibilities

  • Lead concept development and execution for paid media campaigns across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and display platforms.
  • Translate client’s marketing strategy and performance data into clear, compelling ad concepts.
  • Design and direct a range of assets including static ads, animations, mobile-first videos, and storyboards for short-form content.
  • Present creative work to stakeholders and clients with clarity, confidence, and strategic rationale.
  • Monitor performance data in collaboration with the marketing team to inform creative iterations and improve results over time.

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of senior-level design experience, with at least 1 year of people management experience preferred. Must have experience designing ad creatives for paid media campaigns across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, or similar platforms.
  • A digital portfolio showcasing performance-focused ad creative, including static ads, motion graphics, and short-form video, with a strong understanding of visual hierarchy and platform-specific best practices.
  • Knowledge of how to incorporate AI software into workflows to increase efficiencies and output (e.g., ChatGPT, Midjourney, Perplexity, Icon).
  • Self-motivated, proactive, and detail-oriented with ownership of performance results.
  • Experience collaborating with performance marketers and creative strategists to write briefs, incorporate feedback, and iterate based on ad performance data.
  • Strong English communication skills and ability to present creative work clearly and professionally to internal teams and clients.
  • Ability to give constructive feedback to other designers and mentor their growth.
  • Ability to turn ambiguous campaign goals into visually engaging, conversion-focused concepts.
  • Proficiency in Figma (Auto Layout, Components, asset handoff) and Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator) for asset creation.
  • Bonus: experience designing high-performing ads for ecommerce, familiarity with motion design tools (After Effects, Premiere), or working with UGC creators and editors.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We hire A players who want to build something great. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership and support each other relentlessly. We value autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics. If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Remote-first culture with hubs in the Bay Area, New York, Philadelphia, Lisbon, Sao Paulo, and Barcelona.
  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this transition.
  • Opportunities for growth through cross-functional collaboration and skill development.

Equal Opportunity Statement

We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

title: Field Reimbursement Specialist
description:
Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. At Cencora, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose. If you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere.

Field Reimbursement Specialists (FRSs) are responsible for providing field support for patient access to client’s specified products through interaction with the client’s patient support program and provider customers.

FRSs provide their expertise and advanced skills to resolve complex patient access and provider reimbursement issues and to provide educational services across a variety of healthcare provider sites of care.

FRSs work directly with the provider and their office support staff and commonly interact with other reimbursement and patient support services provided by clients.

Play a vital role in helping patients gain access to life-changing therapies! From oral medications to biosimilars to critical cancer treatments, our associates, with their passion for patients, represent these therapies providing education, coverage, and access solutions to healthcare personnel.

FRSs will plan and engage with customers, leveraging client-approved resources, to educate on access and reimbursement topics relevant to assigned client’s product.

Our teams travel weekly, which could include overnight, to healthcare offices within a designated territory, using their knowledge of coverage, patient assistance, and health policy to educate office staff and break through access issues to ultimately help patients.

Typical Day:

  • Educate provider office staff and practice managers on logistics needed to support client product, including infrastructure needed to support in-office administration.
  • Educate provider office staff with understanding the payers’ coverage management strategies for product, including coding, billing, formulary, prior authorization, and appeal processes.
  • Probe to understand office processes and ability to discern root causes of access or reimbursement issues.
  • Deliver interactive educational presentations at various provider sites of service.
  • Provide information on relevant reimbursement topics related to our client’s products based on client’s approval.
  • Performs other related duties as assigned.

Skills and Abilities:

  • Ability to conduct field-based reimbursement and access support, education, and consultation to key account customers and cross-functional partners.
  • Understands the dynamics of Specialty Pharmacy vs. Specialty Distribution.
  • Broad understanding of the physician buy-and-bill model vs. assignment of benefits to alternate sites of care.
  • Experience in revenue cycle, buy and bill, formulary, benefit investigations, prior authorization, coding, and appeals processes.
  • Deep understanding of medical and pharmacy benefits/policies.
  • Live within a reasonable commuting distance of a major airport in the listed location and be able to travel within a territory that includes but may not be limited to MN, WI, IL.

Education and Experience:

  • High School Diploma/GED required.
  • Bachelor's degree or specific Practice Management experience preferred.
  • Project management skills.
  • Experience with extensive travel.

We provide compensation, benefits, and resources that enable a highly inclusive culture and support our team members’ ability to live with purpose every day.

About Grupo QuintoAndar
We are Grupo QuintoAndar, the largest real estate ecosystem in Latin America. Guided by a shared purpose of helping people love where they live, we have a diversified portfolio of brands and solutions across different countries in Latin America, covering all phases of the housing journey. We also have a Technology Hub in Portugal. We develop technology and innovation to transform and enhance the overall living experience.

Location & Remote Work
Our technology team operates under a "remote-first" model, which means we work from home and can live anywhere in Brazil. We also offer the option of working from our São Paulo offices or partner coworking spaces, up to twice a week.

Hiring Process
The stages of our hiring process aim to assess your experiences and allow you to meet our teams and explore career opportunities. They are structured as follows:

  • Application
  • Phone interview with Recruiters
  • Case
  • Interview with Hiring Manager and/or stakeholders
  • Offer

About the team and the role
Staff Product Manager responsibilities at QuintoAndar:

  • Lead a senior product squad, prioritizing its bets and coordinating cross initiatives.
  • Influence business strategy and product organization. Help the business to scale fast and enable sustainable growth.
  • Lead OKRs planning and quarterly roadmap for the squad. Drive strategy and ensure execution flows as planned.
  • Ensure your squad is well organized, productive, and happy. Iterate rituals and integrate product, operations, design, engineering, data, and QA.
  • Deep dive into execution, gather inputs, and discuss the end-game solution with key stakeholders. Set expectations and help the team translate complex problems into product vision and roadmap.
  • Kick-off new discovery streams, anticipate pilots, and validate hypotheses before quarterly planning. Ensure we are using engineering wisely.
  • Study big trends that affect your product. Bring insights from outside and connect dots.
  • Coach APMs. Provide training and invest in people development.
  • Play a key role in the PM hiring process and help us to scale an A-player team.

Requirements

  • Please only apply if you fulfill these:
  • Product track record: you have proven you are a great Product Manager, delivering high-impact solutions.
  • Leadership skills: you have worked in leadership positions, successfully managing cross-functional teams.
  • Hard skills: you are analytical and tuned into industry benchmarks to solve client needs. We seek exceptional problem solvers.
  • Design thinking: demonstrated ability to gather user requirements and convert them into a compelling product vision.
  • Fast pace: you are used to aggressive launch dates and decisions in a fast-changing environment.

We will like you even better if:

  • Your CV includes a couple of years in a very analytical job; strategy consultants as product managers with hands-on experience are valued.
  • You are already leading a high-performing product team.

Important
Our hiring process starts with the application. We analyze all candidates individually and provide feedback to all applicants. All communication will be conducted via email. Please ensure emails from @quintoandar.com.br are not blocked.

Resolvemos problemas complexos e desenvolvemos novas soluções baseadas em tecnologia para estar na vanguarda da indústria de viagens.

Temos um novo desafio para vocês que:

• São protagonistas de seu desenvolvimento profissional e buscam maximizar seu talento.

• São centralizadores de informações e aspiram gerar soluções de alta qualidade.

• São pushers por natureza e se dedicam a fazer as coisas acontecerem.

• São exigentes, competitivos, não se contentam somente com o cumprir mas buscam constantemente se superar.

O Gerente Sênior de Conformidade Fiscal (Tax Compliance Sr Manager) é responsável por liderar os processos de conformidade tributária em cada país, com foco na melhoria de processos, agilidade, precisão e controle inteligente de riscos.

—

Como Sr TAX Analyst você será responsável por:

  • Conformidade fiscal integral, garantindo precisão técnica por meio da incorporação de tecnologia e automação no gerenciamento de dados.
  • Medir e antecipar riscos fiscais relevantes, facilitando a tomada de decisões em conjunto com a gestão, com base no risco assumido.
  • Gerenciar auditorias com consistência técnica e documental, evitando ajustes.
  • Implementar controles inteligentes orientados ao valor fiscal; eliminar aqueles que sejam redundantes ou de baixo impacto (exceto os obrigatórios pelo grupo).
  • Minimizar saldos fiscais imobilizados e ativar estratégias para sua recuperação, maximizando o impacto no fluxo de caixa.
  • Monitorar os saldos contábeis nas contas fiscais e assegurar que não existam itens em aberto sem plano de remediação.
  • Verificar a correta aplicação de benefícios fiscais e impulsionar ativamente a identificação de novas oportunidades.
  • Prestar suporte técnico ao time de Tax Business na definição dos tratamentos fiscais locais.
  • Reportar funcionalmente em linha pontilhada ao Corporate Tax, garantindo qualidade e consistência dos dados.
  • Coordenar os Gerentes locais da Argentina, México, Brasil e países Andinos para o redesenho de processos e eficiência operacional.

Para isso, você precisa ter:

  • Graduação em Ciências Contábeis.
  • Pós-graduação ou especialização em Tributação, desejável.
  • Mais de 10 anos de experiência na área fiscal, com pelo menos 5 anos em cargos de liderança regional ou global.
  • Experiência prévia em ambientes corporativos multinacionais e Big 4.
  • Sólido conhecimento da legislação tributária nos países da América Latina.

title: Senior Creative Performance Strategist
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is a technology-driven growth marketing firm focused on growth-stage consumer companies. We were founded in 2017 out of a conviction that the iconic ad agencies of tomorrow would look very different. Darkroom is a human services firm built on a universal AI commerce layer called Matter. Our model deploys a unique blend of senior, human resources enriched by an agentic technology stack that enhances output, efficiency, and revenue generation for our clients.

Darkroom has been responsible for billions of dollars in trackable revenue across e-commerce marketplaces, direct-to-consumer, and social commerce programs under management. We accelerate results for our portfolio by developing high-impact digital strategies that unlock gateways to revenue growth, transform marketing operations, and prioritize profitability. What started as a boutique design agency evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America, one of the most successful results-driven performance media agencies of the 2020s, and Forbes 30 Under 30 recognition for our founders’ contributions in Marketing & Advertising.

About The Role

We’re looking for a visionary creative leader with deep experience in developing ad concepts for acquisition marketing on Meta. You’ll dive into the pixels and provide tactical feedback on design and video, while threading together performance frameworks, creative testing, and world-building assets. You’re likely a Designer or Creative Strategist by trade but focused on paid media. You’ll work on our Performance Creative service, an AI-powered creative strategy engagement for paid media clients. This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of creativity, AI, and performance—combining bold visual storytelling with data-informed design decisions. You’ll report to the Director of Creative and lead the management of Designers and Editors to execute paid media assets across formats including static ads, short-form videos, motion graphics, and UGC content.

Your work will directly impact client performance by delivering a high volume of ad concepts, elevated creative direction, and data-backed testing frameworks. You’ll collaborate closely with performance marketers, designers, and video editors in a fast-paced, remote environment.

This is a fully remote role operating in the EST Time Zone and all business is conducted 100% in English. Open to candidates in Brazil, Mexico, Portugal, and Spain.

What You’ll Do

Management Responsibilities
  • Manage a team of 2-4 designers focused on paid ad creative, with room to grow the team over time.
  • Provide creative direction, actionable feedback, and career support through regular 1:1s and project reviews.
  • Oversee creative quality, ensuring assets align with brand identity, platform best practices, and campaign objectives.
  • Partner with performance marketers and strategists to develop and iterate on high-performing ad campaigns.
  • Help refine internal processes, establish creative standards, and lead collaborative sessions to drive creative innovation.
Senior Individual Contributor Responsibilities
  • Lead concept development and execution for paid media campaigns across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and display formats.
  • Translate client’s marketing strategy and performance data into clear, compelling ad concepts.
  • Design and direct a range of assets including static ads, animations, mobile-first videos, and storyboards for short-form content.
  • Present creative work to stakeholders and clients with clarity, confidence, and strategic rationale.
  • Monitor performance data in collaboration with the marketing team to inform creative iterations and improve results over time.
You should apply if this sounds like you:
  • 3+ years of senior-level design experience, with at least 1 year of people management experience preferred. Must have experience designing ad creatives for paid media campaigns across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, or similar platforms.
  • A digital portfolio showcasing performance-focused ad creative — including static ads, motion graphics, and short-form video — with a strong understanding of visual hierarchy, composition, and platform-specific best practices.
  • Knowledge of how to incorporate AI software into workflows to increase efficiencies and output, including ChatGPT, Midjourney, Perplexity, Icon, and more.
  • Self-motivated, proactive, and detail-oriented with a strong sense of ownership and accountability to performance results.
  • Skilled at working with performance marketers and creative strategists to write briefs, incorporate feedback, and iterate based on ad performance data.
  • Comfortable communicating in English with internal teams and clients, including presenting creative work and responding to feedback clearly and professionally.
  • Confident giving constructive feedback to other designers and supporting their growth through clear direction and mentorship.
  • Able to take ambiguous campaign goals and turn them into creative concepts that are visually engaging and conversion-focused.
  • Proficient in Figma for ad design workflows; knowledge of Auto Layout, Components, and asset handoff is essential.
  • Experience using Adobe Creative Suite (especially Photoshop and Illustrator) for asset creation and layout design.
  • Bonus: Experience designing high-performing ads for e-commerce brands, familiarity with motion design tools (After Effects, Premiere), or working with UGC creators and editors.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players who want to build something great. There is no room for mediocrity, and candidates not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership, but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape—just world-class talent building something remarkable. We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics. If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote-first culture with a strong community base. With Hubs in the Bay Area, New York, Philly, Lisbon, Sao Paulo, and Barcelona!
  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work-life balance.
  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche through cross-functional collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

title: Staff Product Manager | Explore&Search
description:
Overview

Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in 11 countries, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company.

We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally.

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Staff Product Manager in our Explore&Search Team in Brazil! This is a Remote – Brazil position, meaning you can work from anywhere within the country. Please note that this role is only open to candidates in Brazil.

The Consumer Experience team in Product & Technology is responsible for evolving our product towards providing a simple, engaging and delightful partner discoverability experience, helping users start and cultivate their wellbeing journey with Wellhub.

The Explore & Search team's goal is to evolve the Wellhub app's browsing and search journeys providing users with an increasingly intuitive experience for discovering our diverse range of partners and activities, showcasing Wellhub' value proposition in order to attract, engage, and retain subscribers.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Drive the product vision for providing a great partner discoverability experience for our Members and Subscribers.
  • Defined product requirements, actively collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders within Wellhub to propose new product solutions as well as to continuously review and improve the current product functionality and performance;
  • Analyze and assess product opportunities to unlock better partner discoverability and value perception of Wellhub's network
  • Build, communicate and discuss your product vision with internal stakeholders;
  • Drive product planning, build and manage high quality roadmaps;
  • Work closely with data, product design, engineering, and data science teams to deliver well rounded, scalable and stunning product features;
  • Define goals, metrics, track, and report their progress;
  • Design and run user tests, qualitative surveys, and AB tests.
  • Analyze product data to generate insights and identify opportunities that range from the end user experience all the way to the Search & Recommendation APIs, from improving the way partners are showcased on the interface to rankings and models.
  • Work closely with the Technical Program Manager responsible for the APIs to ensure planning alignment and smooth product improvements cycles.
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life balance.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Experience leading the product development of relevant consumer digital products, in close collaboration with engineering and design team members;
  • Hands on mindset, entrepreneurial and self-driven spirit with a great desire to make things happen;
  • Analytical and quantitative skills is a must, ability to use data and metrics to generate insights, iterate and improve the product;
  • Strong problem solving - be able to structure problems, prioritize and make pragmatic decisions in unstructured environments;
  • Capacity to identify and connect users needs and business needs, and develop effective ideas to meet them
  • Ability to analyze complex requirements and intricate user flows in order to translate them into simple, friendly and intuitive solutions – with attention to detail.
  • Ability to discuss high-level product decisions as well as technical details effectively when necessary
  • Experience with consumer facing digital products. Marketplace experience is a plus.
  • Experience in managing user facing products that integrate with machine learning APIs, search and recommender systems is a plus.
  • Previous experience in search and browsing product journeys is a plus.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don’t match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience in leading the product development of relevant consumer digital products is a mandatory requirement.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life.

Our flexible benefits program allows you to customize some of the benefits, according to your needs!

Our benefits include:

WELLHUB: Free Gold+ membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.

WELLZ: A complete emotional wellbeing program with a unique approach. It offers personalized journeys that combine individual therapy sessions (52 per year) and on-demand content.

HEALTHCARE: Health, dental, and life insurance.

FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. When you join, use our home office reimbursement to set up your home office.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Flexibility for us isn’t just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.

PAID TIME OFF: It’s important to take time away from work to recharge. Employees receive vacations after 6 months and additional 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + an extra holiday for your birthday!

PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled.

CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions, build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success.

CULTURE: You’ll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters.

Questions on how we treat your personal data? See our Privacy notice for Candidates (Aviso de Privacidade para Candidatos).

Somos uma empresa farmacêutica brasileira que há mais de 65 anos trata da vida.   • Apoiar diretamente fóruns multifuncionais, levando análises técnicas robustas e recomendações claras para decisões ágeis.
  • Preparar materiais executivos de alto impacto para as reuniões de S&OP com diretoria/C-level, consolidando riscos, oportunidades e alternativas de decisão.
  • Assegurar governança, compliance e auditoria do processo de S&OP, documentando premissas, decisões e indicadores.
  • Atuar como agente de transformação digital no S&OP, impulsionando uso de BI, RPA, APS e automações para ganho de velocidade e qualidade.
